   1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
   2: """
   3: Runs the complete experimental pipeline end-to-end for the confirmatory study:
   4: 
   5:   CORE (Phase 1 - validation-based tuning + main matrix):
   6:   1. Gradient checks (sanity)                    tests/test_gradients.py
   7:   2. Hyperparameter sweep on STIN (val-based)    experiments/run_hparam_sweep.py
   8:   3. Per-method/arch validation tuning (NEW)     experiments/run_validation_tune.py
   9:   4. Main experiment matrix (15 seeds)           experiments/run_main.py
  10: 
  11:   PHASE 2 (RQ evidence, dual-protocol evaluation):
  12:   5. Purged temporal evaluation (0.02 rad TimeRadians ~22s equiv.) experiments/run_purged_temporal.py
  13:   6. Few-shot uplink sweep (ENHANCED)            experiments/run_fewshot.py
  14:   8. Feature-order stability (NEW)               experiments/run_feature_order.py
  15:   9b. Disentangled task-order study (frozen)      experiments/run_task_order.py
  16:   9c. Exploratory CNN arch tune (validation-scored, not applied) experiments/run_arch_tune.py
  17:   7. Ablation studies (frozen val-tuned hparams) experiments/run_ablation.py
  18:   9. Per-class F1 / confusion matrix analysis    experiments/run_per_class_analysis.py
  19:   10. Paired stats (ACC + Macro-F1, Holm)        experiments/run_stats.py
  20:   11. Robustness/quant/memory ledger             experiments/run_robustness.py
  21:   11b. Feature-provenance leakage ablation       experiments/run_leakage_ablation.py
  22:   11c. Main-vs-fewshot consistency check         experiments/check_consistency.py
  23: 
  24:   REPORTING:
  25:   12. Figures (95% CI, Pareto, dual protocol)   analysis/plots.py
  26:   13. Experiment manifest                        experiments/create_manifest.py
  27:   14. Results summary report                     experiments/generate_summary_report.py
  28: 
  29: Usage:
  30:     python3 run_all.py
  31:     # or skip the slow Phase-2 block:
  32:     python3 run_all.py --no-phase2
  33: 
  34: Uses 4 worker processes by default (CL_JOBS or --jobs overrides); each worker
  35: is pinned to one BLAS thread.  Expect roughly 4-6 hours on a 4-core laptop.
  36: All outputs are written to results/ and figures/.
  37: """
  38: import subprocess
  39: import sys
  40: import time
  41: import os
  42: 
  43: 
  44: STEPS_CORE = [
  45:     ("BiC composition regression test", [sys.executable, "tests/test_bic.py"]),
  46:     ("Exact p-value floor test", [sys.executable, "tests/test_stats_pvalue.py"]),
  47:     ("Task-order split/scaler invariance", [sys.executable, "tests/test_task_order.py"]),
  48:     ("Disjoint calibration/selection split", [sys.executable, "tests/test_calib_split.py"]),
  49:     ("Gradient checks", [sys.executable, "tests/test_gradients.py"]),
  50:     ("Hyperparameter sweep (STIN, val-based)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_hparam_sweep.py"]),
  51:     ("Per-method/arch validation tuning (NEW)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_validation_tune.py"]),
  52:     ("Main experiment matrix (15 seeds)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_main.py"]),
  53: ]
  54: 
  55: STEPS_PHASE2 = [
  56:     ("Purged temporal evaluation (0.02 rad TimeRadians purge)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_purged_temporal.py"]),
  57:     ("Few-shot uplink sweep (ENHANCED)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_fewshot.py"]),
  58:     ("Feature-order stability (NEW)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_feature_order.py"]),
  59:     ("Disentangled task-order study (frozen)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_task_order.py"]),
  60:     ("Exploratory CNN arch tune (validation-scored, not applied)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_arch_tune.py"]),
  61:     ("Ablation studies", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_ablation.py"]),
  62:     ("Matched-memory / EWC-lambda controls", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_baseline_controls.py"]),
  63:     ("Per-class F1 / confusion matrix analysis", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_per_class_analysis.py"]),
  64:     ("Paired stats (ACC + Macro-F1, exact permutation + Holm)", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_stats.py"]),
  65:     ("Robustness/quant/memory ledger", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_robustness.py"]),
  66:     ("Feature-provenance leakage ablation", [sys.executable, "experiments/run_leakage_ablation.py"]),
  67:     ("Main-vs-fewshot consistency check", [sys.executable, "experiments/check_consistency.py"]),
  68: ]
  69: 
  70: STEPS_REPORT = [
  71:     ("Figures (CI, Pareto, dual protocol)", [sys.executable, "analysis/plots.py"]),
  72:     ("Results summary report", [sys.executable, "experiments/generate_summary_report.py"]),
  73:     ("Experiment manifest", [sys.executable, "experiments/create_manifest.py"]),
  74: ]
  75: 
  76: 
  77: def main():
  78:     root = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
  79:     os.chdir(root)
  80: 
  81:     os.environ.setdefault("CL_JOBS", "4")
  82:     for var in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
  83:                 "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS",
  84:                 "BLIS_NUM_THREADS"):
  85:         os.environ[var] = "1"
  86:     print(f"Parallel pipeline: CL_JOBS={os.environ['CL_JOBS']}, "
  87:           "one BLAS thread per worker")
  88:     steps = list(STEPS_CORE)
  89:     if "--no-phase2" not in sys.argv:
  90:         steps += STEPS_PHASE2
  91:     else:
  92:         print("(skipping Phase-2 block: --no-phase2 given)")
  93:     steps += STEPS_REPORT
  94:     t_start = time.perf_counter()
  95:     for name, cmd in steps:
  96:         print(f"\n{'='*70}\n{name}\n{'='*70}")
  97:         t0 = time.perf_counter()
  98:         result = subprocess.run(cmd)
  99:         if result.returncode != 0:
 100:             print(f"\n[FAILED] step '{name}' exited with code {result.returncode}")
 101:             sys.exit(result.returncode)
 102:         print(f"[done in {time.perf_counter()-t0:.1f}s]")
 103:     print(f"\nAll steps completed in {time.perf_counter()-t_start:.1f}s.")
 104:     print("Results: ./results/   Figures: ./figures/")
 105:     print("Read results/RESULTS_SUMMARY.md for the full report.")
 106: 
 107: 
 108: if __name__ == "__main__":
 109:     main()

 223: All configurations fit within the **assumed 60 KB TinyML persistent-state budget** (a conservative study constraint, not a universal CubeSat limit; largest persistent: **18.53 KB**, 30.9% of budget). The `retained_update_state_KB` column is the cumulative calibration half (not the experimental selection half) retained across task updates by EWC/full/BiC; it is not deployed inference state.

 352: MLP's span is small on both datasets, while GRU and CNN1D both show a much larger span, and in both cases ACC *decreases* as lambda increases (visible directly in the per-lambda table above and in `figures/ewc_lambda_sensitivity.png`). This is why final numbers use frozen per-method x per-architecture validation configs instead of one shared configuration.
 353: 
 354: EWC here is online diagonal Fisher with a running estimate (`F_new = γ·F_old + F_current`). The Fisher sample is drawn from a class-balanced mix of the current task's training data and the cumulative calibration pool of all tasks seen so far (not the current task alone), so old-task curvature is not dropped at each consolidation. Frozen per-architecture EWC-only γ weighting: MLP γ=0.5, GRU γ=1.0, CNN1D γ=0.5. γ is treated as a validation-tuned weighting parameter rather than a conventional decay factor; the combined `full` configuration is tuned separately.

 438: ## 6. Per-class F1 -- direct evidence of forgetting
 439: 
 440: Section 2's ACC/BWT/FM numbers are task-level aggregates; this section makes the same phenomenon visible at the level of individual attack classes by evaluating the final trained model (all classes seen so far, single shared head) and computing a per-class precision/recall/F1 breakdown.  587: Combined temporal + no time/ID/window features (the stricter deployment arm):
 588: 
 589: | method        |   mean |    std |
 590: |:--------------|-------:|-------:|
 591: | bic           | 0.1712 | 0.1172 |
 592: | ewc           | 0.25   | 0      |

 598: | lwf           | 0.25   | 0      |
 599: | replay        | 0.0662 | 0.0374 |
 600: 
 601: IID = random-split benchmark; temporal-purged = forward temporal generalization under distribution shift with reduced window overlap (separate estimands, not interpolated). Purge: 0.02 rad on TimeRadians (a proxy for the documented ~20-22 s window horizon; not a wall-clock guarantee). Blocks are ordered on unwrapped circular time so an orbital wrap does not scramble chronology. For classes whose TimeRadians span is narrow, the purge can empty the validation slice; those cells are warned about by the builder and val-dependent methods (BiC/EWC) are correspondingly weaker in this protocol. See DATALOG.md for the drift diagnosis.
 602: 
 603: 
 604: **Interpretation.** The temporal-purged arm is not a small perturbation: deployable-method accuracy falls to roughly the four-class chance level, and the stricter no-leaky arm can fall below it. The IID headline is a benchmark estimand, not deployment evidence; do not read the IID ordering as an operational recommendation.

1101: 
1102: ## 8. Claim boundaries and known limitations
1103: 
1104: This report supports a benchmark/diagnostic reading, not a deployment or method-superiority claim. The main boundaries:
1105: 
1106: - **No scenario-level validation.** CuCD-ID has no scenario/run identifier in the released CSV. A true scenario split is not possible; the time-block proxy is a sensitivity estimand only.
1107: 
1108: - **IID is not deployment.** Sliding-window aggregates and time/identifier features can cross the random train/test boundary. Temporal-purged accuracy collapses, and the stricter no-leaky arm can fall below four-class chance.
1109: 
1110: - **`full` is not the winner.** The combined EWC+replay+BiC configuration is below replay on CuCD-ID for all three architectures. Its tuning grid is smaller, and the lambda=0 control shows the selected EWC strength can be harmful.
1111: 
1112: - **Feature order is exploratory.** The permutation study uses one data split and two training seeds; it does not establish permutation invariance, including for the MLP.
1113: 
1114: - **Task-order modes are not independent.** On primary orders, `fixed_position` and `moves_with_task` are identical by construction because every primary order starts with T0.
1115: 
1116: - **Tuning transfer.** Hyperparameters are tuned on CuCD-ID only; STIN is cross-dataset transfer. Tuning seeds 0-2 overlap the confirmatory seeds, with validation-only selection (no test leakage, but not fully independent).
1117: 
1118: - **Inference is finite-data.** The 216-comparison family is pre-specified and Holm-corrected, but resamples the same finite dataset; it is not evidence about new operating conditions.

  46: # Two-sided 95% Student-t critical values for small samples. Using 1.96 with
  47: # n=10 would understate the interval by roughly 15%; the table is intentionally
  48: # explicit instead of adding a SciPy dependency.
  49: _T_CRIT_95 = {
  50:     1: 12.706, 2: 4.303, 3: 3.182, 4: 2.776, 5: 2.571,
  51:     6: 2.447, 7: 2.365, 8: 2.306, 9: 2.262, 10: 2.228,
  52:     11: 2.201, 12: 2.179, 13: 2.160, 14: 2.145, 15: 2.131,
  53:     16: 2.120, 17: 2.110, 18: 2.101, 19: 2.093, 20: 2.086,
  54:     21: 2.080, 22: 2.074, 23: 2.069, 24: 2.064, 25: 2.060,
  55:     26: 2.056, 27: 2.052, 28: 2.048, 29: 2.045, 30: 2.042,
  56: }
  57: 
  58: 
  59: def ci95(std, n):
  60:     """Half-width of the 95% CI of a mean (t critical * SE)."""
  61:     std = np.asarray(std, dtype=float)
  62:     n = np.asarray(n, dtype=float)
  63:     crit = np.array([_T_CRIT_95.get(int(x), 1.96) for x in np.atleast_1d(n)], dtype=float)
  64:     crit = crit.reshape(np.shape(n))
  65:     return crit * std / np.sqrt(np.maximum(n, 1))
  66:

  72:     cols = [c for c in cols if c in df.columns]
  73:     archs = [a for a in ["MLP", "GRU", "CNN1D"] if a in set(df.arch)]
  74:     for dset in df.dataset.unique():
  75:         sub = df[df.dataset == dset]
  76:         fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(archs), len(cols),
  77:                                  figsize=(4 * len(cols) + 1, 3.0 * len(archs)),
  78:                                  squeeze=False)
  79:         for ai, arch in enumerate(archs):
  80:             arch_sub = sub[sub.arch == arch]
  81:             agg = arch_sub.groupby("method")[cols].agg(["mean", "std", "count"])
  82:             methods = [m for m in METHOD_ORDER if m in agg.index]
  83:             n_seeds = int(arch_sub.seed.nunique()) if "seed" in arch_sub.columns else 0
  84:             for mi, metric in enumerate(cols):
  85:                 ax = axes[ai, mi]
  86:                 means = [agg.loc[m, (metric, "mean")] for m in methods]
  87:                 errs = [ci95(agg.loc[m, (metric, "std")], agg.loc[m, (metric, "count")])
  88:                         for m in methods]
  89:                 colors = [COLORS[m] for m in methods]
  90:                 ax.bar(range(len(methods)), means, yerr=errs, color=colors, capsize=4)
  91:                 ax.set_xticks(range(len(methods)))
  92:                 ax.set_xticklabels([METHOD_LABELS[m].split(" (")[0] for m in methods],
  93:                                    rotation=35, ha="right", fontsize=8)
  94:                 if ai == 0:
  95:                     ax.set_title(metric)
  96:                 if mi == 0:
  97:                     ax.set_ylabel(f"{arch}\nmean")
  98:                 ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.6)
  99:                 ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
 100:         fig.suptitle(f"CL method comparison on {dset} "
 101:                      f"(mean +/- 95% t CI over {n_seeds} seeds; faceted by architecture)")
 102:         savefig(f"method_comparison_{dset}.png")

 105: def fig_forgetting_curves():
 106:     with open(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "accuracy_matrices.json")) as f:
 107:         matrices = json.load(f)
 108:     for dset in ["CuCD-ID", "STIN"]:
 109:         fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))
 110:         for method in METHOD_ORDER:

 113:                 continue
 114:             # average task-0 accuracy trajectory across seeds
 115:             traj = []
 116:             T = len(matrices[key0])
 117:             for seed in SEEDS_ALL:
 118:                 k = f"{dset}|MLP|{method}|{seed}"
 119:                 if k not in matrices:
 120:                     continue
 121:                 R = np.array(matrices[k])
 122:                 traj.append(R[:, 0])  # task-0 accuracy after each subsequent task
 123:             traj = np.nanmean(np.array(traj), axis=0)
 124:             ax.plot(range(1, T + 1), traj, marker="o", label=METHOD_LABELS[method], color=COLORS[method])
 125:         ax.set_xlabel("Tasks learned so far")
 126:         ax.set_ylabel("Accuracy on Task 0 (first-learned task)")
 127:         ax.set_title(f"Retention of the first task while learning new ones -- {dset} (MLP)")
 128:         ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)

 274: def fig_confusion_matrices():
 275:     with open(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "confusion_matrices.json")) as f:
 276:         cms = json.load(f)
 277:     for dset, arch in [("STIN", "GRU"), ("CuCD-ID", "MLP")]:
 278:         fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5.2))
 279:         for ax, method in zip(axes, ["finetune", "icarl"]):
 280:             key = f"{dset}|{arch}|{method}|0"
 281:             if key not in cms:
 282:                 ax.set_visible(False)
 283:                 continue
 284:             entry = cms[key]
 285:             cm = np.array(entry["confusion_matrix"], dtype=float)
 286:             names = entry["class_names"]
 287:             row_sums = cm.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
 288:             cm_norm = np.divide(cm, row_sums, out=np.zeros_like(cm), where=row_sums > 0)
 289:             im = ax.imshow(cm_norm, vmin=0, vmax=1, cmap="viridis")
 290:             ax.set_xticks(range(len(names))); ax.set_xticklabels(names, rotation=60, ha="right", fontsize=7)
 291:             ax.set_yticks(range(len(names))); ax.set_yticklabels(names, fontsize=7)
 292:             ax.set_xlabel("Predicted class"); ax.set_ylabel("True class")
 293:             ax.set_title(METHOD_LABELS.get(method, method))
 294:         handles = [a for a in axes if a.get_visible()]
 295:         if handles:
 296:             fig.colorbar(im, ax=handles[-1], shrink=0.8, label="Row-normalised fraction")
 297:         fig.suptitle(f"Confusion matrix, final model -- {dset} / {arch} (seed 0)\n"
 298:                      "Naive fine-tuning collapses everything into the most-recently-learned class(es)")
 299:         savefig(f"confusion_matrix_{dset}_{arch}.png")

 302: def fig_task_order():
 303:     # Phase-2 disentangled study supersedes the legacy 3-perm confounded one.
 304:     new_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "task_order_disentangled.csv")
 305:     if os.path.exists(new_path):

 308:             df = df[~df["degenerate_single_class_first"]].copy()
 309:         agg = df.groupby(["budget_mode", "method"])["ACC"].agg(["mean", "std", "count"]).reset_index()
 310:         fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 4.5))
 311:         modes = agg.budget_mode.unique()
 312:         methods = [m for m in ["replay", "icarl"] if m in set(agg.method)]
 313:         x = np.arange(len(modes))

 316:             s = agg[agg.method == m].set_index("budget_mode").loc[modes]

 319:         ax.set_xticks(x + width / 2); ax.set_xticklabels(modes)
 320:         ax.set_ylabel("ACC (mean +/- 95% t CI)")
 321:         mode_means = df.groupby("budget_mode")["ACC"].mean()
 322:         budget_gap = float(mode_means.max() - mode_means.min())
 323:         order_means = df.groupby("order")["ACC"].mean()

 325:         ax.set_title("Task-order study, primary two-class-first permutations "
 326:                      "(CuCD-ID, MLP, "
 327:                      f"{df.order.nunique()} perms x 2 budget modes)\n"
 328:                      f"Budget-mode gap={budget_gap:.4f}; per-order mean spread={order_spread:.4f}")
 329:         ax.legend(fontsize=8)
 330:         ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
 331:         savefig("task_order_sensitivity.png")
 332:         return

 334:     agg = df.groupby("order")[["ACC", "BWT"]].agg(["mean", "std", "count"])

  43:     print("\n1. HYPERPARAMETER CONSISTENCY CHECK")
  44:     print("-" * 70)

  46:         if not isinstance(frozen[arch], dict):
  47:             continue  # skip metadata keys like "_note"
  48:         for method in frozen[arch]:

  56:     # CuCD-ID uplink_n_per_class=150; filter dataset to avoid STIN mixing.

  58:     mismatch_count = 0
  59:     k150_diffs = {}

  61:         ("MLP", ["replay", "full", "icarl", "bic"]),

  68:                 (fewshot.arch == arch) & (fewshot.method == method)
  69:                 & (fewshot.K == 150)
  70:                 & (fewshot.calibration_protocol == "fixed")]
  71: 
  72:             if len(main_rows) > 0 and len(fs_rows) > 0:
  73:                 # Compare on intersecting seeds only (main has 10, few-shot has 5)
  74:                 common_seeds = sorted(set(main_rows.seed.tolist()) & set(fs_rows.seed.tolist()))

  76:                 main_acc = main_sub.ACC.mean()
  77:                 fs_acc = fs_rows.ACC.mean()

  82:                 frozen_hp = frozen.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})

  85:                 print(f"    FewShot ACC: {fs_acc:.4f} (n={len(fs_rows)})")

  87:

  90:                     mismatch_count += 1
  91:                 else:
  92:                     print(f"    OK: Difference <= 0.05")

  94:                 print(f"\n  {arch:5s} / {method:10s}: SKIP (missing data)")

  97:     print("-" * 70)
  98:     # Check that main experiment used the pre-specified seed set
  99:     main_seeds = sorted(main_runs.seed.unique())
 100:     print(f"Main experiment seeds: {main_seeds}")
 101:     if main_seeds != list(SEEDS):
 102:         print(f"  *** WARNING: Expected seeds {SEEDS}, got {main_seeds} ***")
 103:         mismatch_count += 1
 104:     else:
 105:         print(f"  OK: {len(SEEDS)} seeds used")
 106: 
 107:     # Check few-shot used 5 seeds
 108:     fs_seeds = sorted(fewshot.seed.unique())
 109:     print(f"Few-shot seeds: {fs_seeds}")
 110:     if fs_seeds != list(range(5)):
 111:         print(f"  *** WARNING: Expected seeds 0-4, got {fs_seeds} ***")
 112:         mismatch_count += 1
 113:     else:
 114:         print("  OK: 5 seeds (0-4) used")
 115: 
 116:     print("\n4. HYPERPARAMETER SOURCE CHECK")
 117:     print("-" * 70)
 118:     # Assert the frozen file covers every tuned method x architecture and
 119:     # that K=150 numerics already matched above on intersecting seeds.
 120:     expected_methods = {"finetune", "replay", "ewc", "full", "lwf", "bic",
 121:                         "icarl", "joint", "joint_scratch"}
 122:     expected_archs = {"MLP", "GRU", "CNN1D"}
 123:     missing = [(a, m) for a in expected_archs for m in expected_methods
 124:                if not frozen.get(a, {}).get(m, {}).get("hparams")]
 125:     extra = [(a, m) for a in frozen for m in frozen.get(a, {})
 126:              if a not in expected_archs or m not in expected_methods]
 127:     if extra:
 128:         print(f"  NOTE: extra frozen entries present: {extra}")
 129:     if missing:
 130:         print(f"  *** WARNING: missing frozen configs: {missing} ***")
 131:         mismatch_count += 1
 132:     else:
 133:         print(f"  OK: frozen configs cover {len(expected_archs)} archs x "
 134:               f"{len(expected_methods)} methods")
 135: 
 136:     print("\n" + "=" * 70)
 137:     status = "pass" if mismatch_count == 0 else "fail"
 138:     if mismatch_count == 0:
 139:         print("ALL CHECKS PASSED - No inconsistencies detected")
 140:     else:
 141:         print(f"{mismatch_count} ISSUE(S) DETECTED - Review required")
 142:     with open(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "consistency_check.json"), "w") as f:
 143:         json.dump({
 144:             "status": status,
 145:             "mismatch_count": mismatch_count,

   1: import sys, os
   2: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
   3: 
   4: from models import CubeSatMLP, CubeSatGRU, CubeSat1DCNN
   5: from tuning_grids import (VAL_FRAC, CALIB_FRAC, VAL_CAP_PER_CLASS,
   6:                           CALIB_CAP_PER_CLASS, SELECT_CAP_PER_CLASS)
   7: 
   8: ARCHS = ["MLP", "GRU", "CNN1D"]
   9: # Phase 1: lwf (distill-only), bic (replay+distill+BiC), icarl (herding+distill),
  10: # joint_scratch (from-scratch offline joint-training reference; not a strict
  11: # upper bound). `joint` kept as legacy
  12: # cumulative warm-start for comparability with old CSVs.
  13: METHODS = ["finetune", "replay", "ewc", "full", "lwf", "bic", "icarl", "joint", "joint_scratch"]
  14: # 15 seeds: with 216 all-pairwise comparisons, the exact sign-flip floor is
  15: # 2/2^15 = 6.1e-5, so a Holm-adjusted comparison can reach p<0.05 (10 seeds
  16: # cannot: 2/2^10 * 216 = 0.42).  The count is fixed before the confirmatory run.
  17: SEEDS = list(range(15))
  18: 
  19: MODEL_CLASSES = {"MLP": CubeSatMLP, "GRU": CubeSatGRU, "CNN1D": CubeSat1DCNN}
  20: 
  21: DATA_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "data")
  22: RESULTS_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "results")
  23: FIGURES_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "figures")
  24: 
  25: 
  26: def validate_frozen_hparams(data):
  27:     """Ensure every architecture/method has a non-empty frozen hparams entry."""
  28:     problems = []
  29:     for arch in ARCHS:
  30:         arch_entry = data.get(arch) if isinstance(data, dict) else None
  31:         if not isinstance(arch_entry, dict):
  32:             problems.append(f"{arch}: missing architecture entry")
  33:             continue
  34:         for method in METHODS:
  35:             entry = arch_entry.get(method)
  36:             if not isinstance(entry, dict):
  37:                 problems.append(f"{arch}/{method}: missing method entry")
  38:                 continue
  39:             hp = entry.get("hparams")
  40:             if not isinstance(hp, dict) or not hp:
  41:                 problems.append(f"{arch}/{method}: missing non-empty hparams")
  42:             elif "lr" not in hp or "epochs" not in hp:
  43:                 problems.append(f"{arch}/{method}: hparams missing lr/epochs")
  44:     if problems:
  45:         raise ValueError(
  46:             "Incomplete frozen hyperparameter file: " + "; ".join(problems)
  47:             + ". Re-run `python3 experiments/run_validation_tune.py`."
  48:         )
  49:     return data
  50: 
  51: 
  52: def load_frozen_hparams_strict():
  53:     """Load per-method/arch frozen hyperparameters, failing loudly if absent.
  54: 
  55:     Every experiment downstream of validation tuning must call this instead of
  56:     falling back to legacy or default configs: a missing or incomplete frozen
  57:     file means the pipeline ran out of order (or tuning failed), and silently
  58:     training on wrong hyperparameters would produce a valid-looking but
  59:     invalid matrix.
  60:     """
  61:     import json
  62:     path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams_per_method_arch.json")
  63:     if not os.path.exists(path):
  64:         raise FileNotFoundError(
  65:             f"Frozen hyperparameters not found at {path}. "
  66:             "Run `python3 experiments/run_validation_tune.py` first "
  67:             "(via `python3 run_all.py`), then re-run this step. "
  68:             "Refusing to fall back to legacy/default configs."
  69:         )
  70:     with open(path) as f:
  71:         return validate_frozen_hparams(json.load(f))
  72: 
  73: BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS = dict(epochs=25, batch_size=32, fisher_n_samples=200)
  74: 
  75: # LEGACY only: per-arch overrides applied on top of BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS +
  76: # coarse STIN sweep winners. Superseded by frozen per-method x
  77: # per-architecture validation configs
  78: # (results/best_hparams_per_method_arch.json), which ALREADY include
  79: # per-arch CNN tuning (CNN1D replay/icarl lr=0.01). No live pipeline code
  80: # calls hparams_for() anymore; kept so dormant scripts keep importing.
  81: ARCH_TUNED_HPARAMS = {
  82:     "CNN1D": dict(lr=0.01, epochs=50),
  83: }
  84: 
  85: 
  86: def hparams_for(arch: str, best_hp: dict) -> dict:
  87:     """Legacy fallback merge: BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS < sweep winners < per-arch
  88:     overrides. Superseded by frozen per-method/arch configs; kept only so the
  89:     legacy fallback path in run_main.py keeps working."""
  90:     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **best_hp}
  91:     hp.update(ARCH_TUNED_HPARAMS.get(arch, {}))
  92:     return hp
  93: 
  94: 
  95: def model_kwargs_for(arch: str, n_features: int) -> dict:
  96:     if arch == "MLP":
  97:         return dict(input_dim=n_features, h1=32, h2=16)
  98:     if arch == "GRU":
  99:         divisors = [d for d in range(2, n_features) if n_features % d == 0]
 100:         seq_len = min(divisors, key=lambda d: abs(d - 10)) if divisors else n_features
 101:         return dict(input_dim=n_features, seq_len=seq_len, hidden=10)
 102:     if arch == "CNN1D":
 103:         return dict(input_dim=n_features, c1=6, c2=10, kernel=3)
 104:     raise ValueError(arch)

  13: def df_to_md(df, float_fmt="{:.4f}"):
  14:     df = df.copy()
  15:     for c in df.columns:
  16:         if pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(df[c]):
  17:             df[c] = df[c].map(lambda x: float_fmt.format(x) if pd.notnull(x) else "")
  18:     return df.to_markdown(index=False)

  22:     out = []

  25:                 "`experiments/generate_summary_report.py` directly from the CSV/JSON "
  26:                 "outputs of the experiment scripts -- every number below is a real, "

 514:                                 "cohens_d", "p_exact", "p_holm"] if c in st.columns]
 515:             out.append(df_to_md(st.sort_values("mean_diff", ascending=False)[cols]))
 516:         else:
 517:             out.append(f"\n_({metric_file} not found -- run "
 518:                         f"`experiments/run_stats.py` first)_\n")

 520:     out.append("\n## 8. Claim boundaries and known limitations\n")
 521:     out.append("This report supports a benchmark/diagnostic reading, not a "
 522:                "deployment or method-superiority claim. The main boundaries:\n")
 523:     out.append("- **No scenario-level validation.** CuCD-ID has no scenario/run "
 524:                "identifier in the released CSV. A true scenario split is not "

FILE: ./experiments/run_ablation.py (4.6 KB)

   1: """
   2: Ablation study, run on top of the FROZEN per-method/arch hyperparameters
   3: from validation tuning (not the single sweep winners). This ensures each
   4: method/architecture combination uses its own optimized configuration.
   5: 
   6:   (a) Replay buffer capacity sensitivity   -- CuCD-ID + STIN, all 3
   7:                                                 architectures, method=full
   8:   (b) EWC lambda sensitivity                -- CuCD-ID + STIN, all 3
   9:                                                 architectures, method=full
  10: 
  11: NOTE: the legacy 3-permutation task-order ablation was removed here; the
  12: disentangled 12-permutation study (`run_task_order.py`,
  13: `task_order_disentangled.csv`) supersedes it (see results/legacy/README.md).
  14: """
  15: import sys, os, json, itertools, time
  16: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  17: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  18: 
  19: from parallel import configure_single_thread, describe, parallel_map, get_jobs
  20: configure_single_thread()
  21: 
  22: import numpy as np
  23: import pandas as pd
  24: 
  25: import data_utils as du
  26: from train import train_continual
  27: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics
  28: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  29:                     BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, SEEDS, VAL_FRAC)
  30: 
  31: 
  32: def load_frozen_hparams():
  33:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  34:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  35:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  36: 
  37: 
  38: def get_task_seqs():
  39:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  40:                                os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
  41:     stin_df = du.load_stin(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "SAT20.csv"),
  42:                            os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "TER20.csv"))
  43:     return cucd_df, stin_df
  44: 
  45: 
  46: def get_frozen_hp(frozen_hparams, arch, method):
  47:     """Get frozen hyperparameters for a specific arch/method."""
  48:     return frozen_hparams.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  49: 
  50: 
  51: CAPACITIES = [32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024]
  52: LAMBDAS = [0, 10, 100, 1000, 5000, 20000, 50000]
  53: ARCHS_ABL = ["MLP", "GRU", "CNN1D"]
  54: _FROZEN = None
  55: _TS = {}
  56: 
  57: 
  58: def _run_one(item):
  59:     dset_name, arch, kind, value, seed = item
  60:     ts = _TS[(dset_name, seed)]
  61:     base_hp = get_frozen_hp(_FROZEN, arch, "full")
  62:     if kind == "buffer":
  63:         hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **base_hp, "buffer_capacity": value}
  64:         row_key = {"buffer_capacity": value}
  65:     else:
  66:         hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **base_hp, "ewc_lambda": value}
  67:         row_key = {"ewc_lambda": value}
  68:     mk = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  69:     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], mk, ts, "full", hp, seed=seed)
  70:     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
  71:     return dict(dataset=dset_name, arch=arch, seed=seed, **row_key, **m)
  72: 
  73: 
  74: def main():
  75:     global _FROZEN, _TS
  76:     _FROZEN = load_frozen_hparams()
  77:     cucd_df, stin_df = get_task_seqs()
  78:     for seed in SEEDS:
  79:         _TS[("CuCD-ID", seed)] = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(
  80:             cucd_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
  81:         _TS[("STIN", seed)] = du.build_stin_tasks(
  82:             stin_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
  83: 
  84:     items = (
  85:         [(dset, arch, "buffer", cap, seed)
  86:          for dset in ("CuCD-ID", "STIN")
  87:          for arch in ARCHS_ABL
  88:          for cap in CAPACITIES
  89:          for seed in SEEDS]
  90:         + [(dset, arch, "ewc", lam, seed)
  91:            for dset in ("CuCD-ID", "STIN")
  92:            for arch in ARCHS_ABL
  93:            for lam in LAMBDAS
  94:            for seed in SEEDS]
  95:     )
  96:     jobs = get_jobs()
  97:     print(f"Ablations: {len(items)} runs; {describe(jobs)}")
  98:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
  99:     rows = []
 100:     for i, row in enumerate(parallel_map(_run_one, items, jobs=jobs), 1):
 101:         rows.append(row)
 102:         if i % 30 == 0 or i == len(items):
 103:             print(f"  [{i}/{len(items)}] {row['dataset']} {row['arch']} "
 104:                   f"({time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
 105: 
 106:     df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
 107:     buf = df[df.get("buffer_capacity").notna()].copy()
 108:     ewc = df[df.get("ewc_lambda").notna()].copy()
 109:     buf.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "ablation_buffer_size.csv"), index=False)
 110:     ewc.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "ablation_ewc_lambda.csv"), index=False)
 111: 
 112:     print("\n[Ablation A] Buffer capacity sensitivity, all 3 architectures "
 113:           "(mean over seeds):")
 114:     print(buf.groupby(["dataset", "arch", "buffer_capacity"])[["ACC", "BWT", "FM"]]
 115:           .mean().round(4))
 116:     print("\n[Ablation B] EWC lambda sensitivity, both datasets x 3 architectures "
 117:           "(mean over seeds):")
 118:     print(ewc.groupby(["dataset", "arch", "ewc_lambda"])[["ACC", "BWT", "FM"]]
 119:           .mean().round(4))
 120:     print(f"\nDone ({time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
 121: 
 122: 
 123: if __name__ == "__main__":
 124:     main()

FILE: ./experiments/run_arch_tune.py (3.5 KB)
================================================================================
   1: """Phase 2a: per-architecture LR/epoch tune (CNN flag).
   2: 
   3: Motivation: full-matrix evidence shows CNN `joint_scratch < joint(warm)` on
   4: both datasets (CuCD-ID 0.858 vs 0.898; STIN 0.395 vs 0.535) while MLP/GRU
   5: have scratch >= joint. That pattern points at optimization (LR/epochs for
   6: the conv trunk), not at continual learning. The frozen STIN/MLP hparams
   7: (lr=0.003, epochs=25) were never tuned for CNN.
   8: 
   9: Scope (kept small on purpose): CuCD-ID only, CNN1D only, methods
  10: replay/icarl/joint_scratch (replay = continual reference, scratch = upper
  11: bound whose gap must close under a fair tune). 3 seeds for speed.
  12: EXPLORATORY ONLY: selection uses validation (V) metrics; winners are NOT
  13: applied to reported numbers (per-method/arch frozen configs govern).
  14: 
  15: Writes: results/arch_tune.csv (one row per lr x epochs x method x seed).
  16: """
  17: import sys
  18: import os
  19: import itertools
  20: import time
  21: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  22: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  23: 
  24: from parallel import configure_single_thread, describe, parallel_map, get_jobs
  25: configure_single_thread()
  26: 
  27: import numpy as np
  28: import pandas as pd
  29: 
  30: import data_utils as du
  31: from train import train_continual
  32: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics
  33: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  34:                     BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, VAL_FRAC)
  35: 
  36: 
  37: def load_frozen_hparams():
  38:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  39:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  40:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  41: 
  42: LR_GRID = [1e-3, 3e-3, 1e-2]
  43: EPOCH_GRID = [25, 50]
  44: METHODS = ["replay", "icarl", "joint_scratch"]
  45: SEEDS = [0, 1, 2]
  46: _FROZEN = None
  47: _TS = {}
  48: 
  49: 
  50: def _run_one(item):
  51:     lr, epochs, method, seed = item
  52:     ts = _TS[seed]
  53:     base_hp = _FROZEN.get("CNN1D", {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  54:     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **base_hp, "lr": lr, "epochs": epochs}
  55:     out = train_continual(
  56:         MODEL_CLASSES["CNN1D"], model_kwargs_for("CNN1D", ts.n_features),
  57:         ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  58:     if out.get("V") is None or np.all(np.isnan(out["V"])):
  59:         raise RuntimeError(f"No selection rows for CNN1D/{method} seed={seed}")
  60:     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["V"])
  61:     return dict(lr=lr, epochs=epochs, method=method, seed=seed, **m)
  62: 
  63: 
  64: def main():
  65:     global _FROZEN, _TS
  66:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
  67:     _FROZEN = load_frozen_hparams()
  68:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  69:                               os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
  70:     for seed in SEEDS:
  71:         _TS[seed] = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(
  72:             cucd_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
  73:     items = list(itertools.product(LR_GRID, EPOCH_GRID, METHODS, SEEDS))
  74:     jobs = get_jobs()
  75:     print(f"CNN tune: {len(items)} runs; {describe(jobs)}")
  76:     rows = []
  77:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
  78:     for i, row in enumerate(parallel_map(_run_one, items, jobs=jobs), 1):
  79:         rows.append(row)
  80:         if i % 9 == 0 or i == len(items):
  81:             print(f"  [{i}/{len(items)}] lr={row['lr']} epochs={row['epochs']} "
  82:                   f"{row['method']} seed={row['seed']} ACC={row['ACC']:.3f} "
  83:                   f"({time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
  84:     df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
  85:     df.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "arch_tune.csv"), index=False)
  86:     print("\nMean ACC per (method, lr, epochs):")
  87:     print(df.groupby(["method", "lr", "epochs"])["ACC"].mean().round(3).to_string())
  88:     print(f"\nWrote results/arch_tune.csv ({len(df)} runs, {time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
  89: 
  90: 
  91: if __name__ == "__main__":
  92:     main()

  37: def _build_controls(frozen):
  38:     controls = []
  39:     for arch in ARCHS:
  40:         replay_hp = frozen[arch]["replay"]["hparams"]
  41:         full_hp = frozen[arch]["full"]["hparams"]
  42:         ewc_hp = frozen[arch]["ewc"]["hparams"]
  43:         controls.append(("replay_matched", "replay", arch, {
  44:             **replay_hp,
  45:             "buffer_capacity": int(full_hp["buffer_capacity"]),
  46:             "replay_frac": float(full_hp["replay_frac"]),
  47:         }))
  48:         for lam in (0.0, 10.0):
  49:             controls.append((f"ewc_l{int(lam)}", "ewc", arch, {
  50:                 **ewc_hp, "ewc_lambda": lam,
  51:             }))
  52:             controls.append((f"full_l{int(lam)}", "full", arch, {
  53:                 **full_hp, "ewc_lambda": lam,
  54:             }))
  55:     return controls
  56: 
  57: 
  58: def compute_stats(df):
  59:     main_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "main_results_runs.csv")
  60:     if not os.path.exists(main_path):
  61:         print("WARNING: main_results_runs.csv missing; skipping paired stats.")
  62:         return
  63:     main_df = pd.read_csv(main_path)
  64:     refs = {
  65:         "replay_matched": "replay",
  66:         "ewc_l0": "ewc", "ewc_l10": "ewc",
  67:         "full_l0": "full", "full_l10": "full",
  68:     }
  69:     stat_rows = []
  70:     for metric in ("ACC",):
  71:         metric_rows = []
  72:         for condition, ref_method in refs.items():
  73:             for (dset_name, arch), group in df.groupby(["dataset", "arch"]):
  74:                 cond = group[group.condition == condition]
  75:                 ref = main_df[(main_df.dataset == dset_name) &
  76:                               (main_df.arch == arch) &
  77:                               (main_df.method == ref_method)]
  78:                 merged = cond.merge(ref, on=["dataset", "arch", "seed"],
  79:                                     suffixes=("_cond", "_ref"))
  80:                 if len(merged) < 2:
  81:                     continue
  82:                 res = paired_permutation_test(
  83:                     merged[f"{metric}_cond"].to_numpy(),
  84:                     merged[f"{metric}_ref"].to_numpy())
  85:                 metric_rows.append({
  86:                     "metric": metric,
  87:                     "comparison": f"{condition} vs {ref_method}",
  88:                     "condition": condition, "reference": ref_method,
  89:                     "dataset": dset_name, "arch": arch,
  90:                     "n_pairs": int(len(merged)),
  91:                     "mean_cond": float(merged[f"{metric}_cond"].mean()),
  92:                     "mean_ref": float(merged[f"{metric}_ref"].mean()),
  93:                     **res,
  94:                 })
  95:         if metric_rows:
  96:             p_adj = holm_correction([r["p"] for r in metric_rows])
  97:             for r, pa in zip(metric_rows, p_adj):
  98:                 r["p_holm"] = float(pa)
  99:                 stat_rows.extend([r])
 100:     stats = pd.DataFrame(stat_rows)
 101:     stat_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "stats_baseline_controls.csv")
 102:     stats.to_csv(stat_path, index=False)
 103:     print(f"Wrote {stat_path} ({len(stats)} comparisons)")
 104:     if not stats.empty:
 105:         print(stats[["metric", "comparison", "dataset", "arch",
 106:                      "mean_diff", "p", "p_holm"]].to_string(index=False))
 107: 
 108: 
 109: def parse_args():
 110:     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
 111:     ap.add_argument("--stats-only", action="store_true",
 112:                     help="Do not train; recompute paired stats from existing CSV.")
 113:     return ap.parse_args()
 114:

 118: _CONTROLS = []

 123:     ts = _DATASETS[(dset_name, seed)]
 124:     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **hp_extra}
 125:     out = train_continual(

 127:         ts, method, hp, seed=seed)

 131:         seed=seed, **m,
 132:         buffer_capacity=hp.get("buffer_capacity"),
 133:         replay_frac=hp.get("replay_frac"),
 134:         ewc_lambda=hp.get("ewc_lambda"),
 135:         lr=hp.get("lr"), epochs=hp.get("epochs"),
 136:         train_seconds=float(sum(out["per_task_train_seconds"])),
 137:     )
 138:

 140: def main():
 141:     global _FROZEN, _DATASETS, _CONTROLS
 142:     args = parse_args()
 143:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
 144:     out_csv = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "baseline_controls.csv")
 145:     if args.stats_only:
 146:         if not os.path.exists(out_csv):
 147:             raise SystemExit(f"{out_csv} missing; run training first")
 148:         compute_stats(pd.read_csv(out_csv))
 149:         return
 150: 
 151:     _FROZEN = load_frozen_hparams_strict()
 152:     cucd = du.load_cucd_id(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
 153:                            os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
 154:     stin = du.load_stin(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "SAT20.csv"),
 155:                         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "TER20.csv"))
 156:     for seed in SEEDS:
 157:         _DATASETS[("CuCD-ID", seed)] = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(
 158:             cucd, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
 159:         _DATASETS[("STIN", seed)] = du.build_stin_tasks(
 160:             stin, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
 161: 
 162:     _CONTROLS = _build_controls(_FROZEN)
 163:     items = [(dset_name, condition, method, arch, hp_extra, seed)
 164:              for dset_name in ("CuCD-ID", "STIN")
 165:              for condition, method, arch, hp_extra in _CONTROLS
 166:              for seed in SEEDS]
 167:     jobs = get_jobs()
 168:     print(f"Baseline controls: {len(items)} runs; {describe(jobs)}")
 169:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
 170:     rows = []
 171:     for i, row in enumerate(parallel_map(_run_one, items, jobs=jobs), 1):
 172:         rows.append(row)
 173:         if i % 10 == 0 or i == len(items):
 174:             print(f"  [{i}/{len(items)}] {row['dataset']} {row['arch']} "
 175:                   f"{row['condition']} seed={row['seed']} "
 176:                   f"({time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
 177:

 179:     df.to_csv(out_csv, index=False)
 180:     print(f"\nWrote {out_csv} ({len(df)} runs)")

  83:              for arch in ARCHS
  84:              for perm_idx in range(len(perms))
  85:              for method in METHODS
  86:              for seed in SEEDS]
  87:     jobs = get_jobs()
  88:     print(f"Feature-order stability: {len(items)} runs; {describe(jobs)}")
  89:     t_start = time.perf_counter()

  92:         rows.append(row)
  93:         if i % 24 == 0 or i == len(items):

 103:     for arch in ARCHS:
 104:         arch_df = df[df.arch == arch]
 105:         orig = arch_df[arch_df.is_original].groupby("method")["ACC"].mean()
 106:         permd = arch_df[~arch_df.is_original].groupby("method")["ACC"].mean()
 107:         print(f"\n{arch}:")
 108:         for method in METHODS:
 109:             if method in orig.index and method in permd.index:
 110:                 drop = orig[method] - permd[method]
 111:                 print(f"  {method:10s}: orig={orig[method]:.3f} "
 112:                       f"perm={permd[method]:.3f} drop={drop:+.3f}")
 113: 
 114:     print(f"\nWrote {output_path} ({len(df)} runs, "
 115:           f"{time.perf_counter()-t_start:.1f}s)")

FILE: ./experiments/run_fewshot.py (5.3 KB)

   1: """Phase 2b: few-shot uplink sweep (RQ4), confirmatory protocol.
   2: 
   3: Question: how many labelled samples per new attack must be uplinked for a
   4: reliable onboard update?  Varies the adaptation budget K (samples/class for
   5: T1..T3; T0 pre-launch corpus fixed at 700/class) on CuCD-ID.
   6: 
   7: Two calibration protocols are reported:
   8:   * fixed  -- 150 calibration rows/class, 150 disjoint selection rows/class
   9:               (the deployment payload for calibration-based methods).
  10:   * scaled -- K calibration rows/class, K disjoint selection rows/class,
  11:               so calibration and adaptation budgets grow together.
  12: 
  13: Calibration payload is counted only for methods that consume it
  14: (ewc/full/bic).  Replay and iCaRL are calibration-free and no longer carry a
  15: phantom 10 KB calibration charge.  The selection half is used only for
  16: hyperparameter scoring and is never counted as onboard payload.
  17: 
  18: Writes: results/fewshot.csv (one row per protocol x arch x method x K x seed).
  19: """
  20: import sys
  21: import os
  22: import time
  23: 
  24: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  25: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  26: 
  27: from parallel import configure_single_thread, describe, parallel_map, get_jobs
  28: configure_single_thread()
  29: 
  30: import numpy as np
  31: import pandas as pd
  32: 
  33: import data_utils as du
  34: from train import train_continual
  35: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics, compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc
  36: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  37:                     BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, VAL_FRAC, VAL_CAP_PER_CLASS,
  38:                     CALIB_CAP_PER_CLASS)
  39: from run_main import final_detection_metrics
  40: 
  41: K_GRID = [5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 150, 300]
  42: PROTOCOLS = ["fixed", "scaled"]
  43: CALIB_METHODS = {"ewc", "full", "bic"}
  44: PLAN = [
  45:     ("MLP", ["replay", "full", "icarl", "bic"], list(range(5))),
  46:     ("GRU", ["replay", "icarl"], list(range(5))),
  47: ]
  48: T0_N = 700
  49: 
  50: _FROZEN = None
  51: _TS = {}
  52: 
  53: 
  54: def load_frozen_hparams():
  55:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  56:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  57:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  58: 
  59: 
  60: def _build_tasks(cucd_df):
  61:     """Pre-build all task sequences before forking so workers share them."""
  62:     global _TS
  63:     _TS = {}
  64:     for protocol in PROTOCOLS:
  65:         for K in K_GRID:
  66:             val_cap = VAL_CAP_PER_CLASS if protocol == "fixed" else 2 * K
  67:             for seed in range(5):
  68:                 _TS[(protocol, K, seed)] = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(
  69:                     cucd_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC,
  70:                     initial_n_per_class=T0_N,
  71:                     uplink_n_per_class=K,
  72:                     val_cap_per_class=val_cap)
  73: 
  74: 
  75: def _run_one(item):
  76:     arch, method, protocol, K, seed = item
  77:     ts = _TS[(protocol, K, seed)]
  78:     mk = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  79:     hp = {**_BASE_HP, **_FROZEN.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})}
  80:     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], mk, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  81:     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
  82:     mf_ba = compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc(
  83:         out["model"], ts, out.get("corrector"))
  84:     det = final_detection_metrics(ts, out)
  85:     adaptation_kb = float(sum(t.uplink_bytes_int8 for t in ts.tasks[1:]) / 1024.0)
  86:     uses_calib = method in CALIB_METHODS
  87:     calib_kb = (float(sum(t.uplink_calib_bytes_int8 for t in ts.tasks[1:]) / 1024.0)
  88:                 if uses_calib else 0.0)
  89:     return dict(
  90:         calibration_protocol=protocol,
  91:         calib_cap_per_class=(CALIB_CAP_PER_CLASS if protocol == "fixed" else K),
  92:         uses_calibration=uses_calib,
  93:         arch=arch, method=method, K=K, seed=seed,
  94:         uplink_KB_total=round(adaptation_kb, 2),
  95:         uplink_KB_calib=round(calib_kb, 2),
  96:         uplink_KB_total_with_calib=round(adaptation_kb + calib_kb, 2),
  97:         **m, **mf_ba,
  98:         DET_AUROC=det["DET_AUROC"],
  99:     )
 100: 
 101: 
 102: _BASE_HP = {}
 103: 
 104: 
 105: def main():
 106:     global _FROZEN, _BASE_HP
 107:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
 108:     _FROZEN = load_frozen_hparams()
 109:     _BASE_HP = dict(BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS)
 110: 
 111:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(
 112:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
 113:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
 114:     _build_tasks(cucd_df)
 115: 
 116:     items = []
 117:     for protocol in PROTOCOLS:
 118:         for arch, methods, seeds in PLAN:
 119:             for K in K_GRID:
 120:                 for method in methods:
 121:                     for seed in seeds:
 122:                         items.append((arch, method, protocol, K, seed))
 123: 
 124:     jobs = get_jobs()
 125:     print(f"Few-shot sweep: {len(items)} runs; {describe(jobs)}")
 126:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
 127:     rows = []
 128:     for i, row in enumerate(parallel_map(_run_one, items, jobs=jobs), 1):
 129:         rows.append(row)
 130:         if i % 20 == 0 or i == len(items):
 131:             print(f"  [{i}/{len(items)}] {row['calibration_protocol']} "
 132:                   f"{row['arch']} {row['method']} K={row['K']} seed={row['seed']} "
 133:                   f"ACC={row['ACC']:.3f} ({time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
 134: 
 135:     df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
 136:     df.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "fewshot.csv"), index=False)
 137:     print("\nMean ACC per (protocol, arch, method, K):")
 138:     print(df.groupby(["calibration_protocol", "arch", "method", "K"])["ACC"]
 139:           .mean().round(3).to_string())
 140:     print(f"\nWrote results/fewshot.csv ({len(df)} runs, "
 141:           f"{time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
 142: 
 143: 
 144: if __name__ == "__main__":
 145:     main()

FILE: ./experiments/run_hparam_sweep.py (3.4 KB)
================================================================================
   1: """
   2: Hyperparameter sweep for the CMMU (learning rate, EWC lambda, replay-buffer
   3: capacity, replay fraction). Performed on STIN (the secondary / stress-test
   4: dataset), using the MLP architecture as a fast proxy, method='full'
   5: (replay+EWC jointly, i.e. the config that will actually be deployed).
   6: 
   7: Hyperparameters are selected on VALIDATION performance to avoid test-set leakage.
   8: The winning configuration is a COARSE PRIOR only (STIN/MLP/full proxy) --
   9: final per-method x per-architecture hyperparameters come from
  10: experiments/run_validation_tune.py on CuCD-ID validation and are frozen to
  11: results/best_hparams_per_method_arch.json. Nothing here is reused globally.
  12: """
  13: import sys, os, json, itertools, time
  14: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  15: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  16: 
  17: from parallel import configure_single_thread, describe, parallel_map, get_jobs
  18: configure_single_thread()
  19: 
  20: import numpy as np
  21: import pandas as pd
  22: 
  23: import data_utils as du
  24: from train import train_continual
  25: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics
  26: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  27:                     BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, VAL_FRAC)
  28: 
  29: GRID = dict(
  30:     lr=[1e-3, 3e-3],
  31:     ewc_lambda=[100, 1000, 5000, 20000],
  32:     buffer_capacity=[64, 128, 256, 512, 1024],
  33:     replay_frac=[0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9],
  34: )
  35: 
  36: 
  37: _TS = None
  38: _MK = None
  39: 
  40: 
  41: def _run_combo(hp):
  42:     full_hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **hp}
  43:     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES["MLP"], _MK, _TS, "full", full_hp, seed=0)
  44:     if out.get("V") is None or np.all(np.isnan(out["V"])):
  45:         raise RuntimeError("No selection rows for STIN sweep")
  46:     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["V"])
  47:     score = m["ACC"] - max(m["FM"], 0.0)
  48:     return {**hp, **m, "score": score}
  49: 
  50: 
  51: def main():
  52:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
  53:     df = du.load_stin(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "SAT20.csv"),
  54:                        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "TER20.csv"))
  55:     ts = du.build_stin_tasks(df, seed=0, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
  56:     model_kwargs = model_kwargs_for("MLP", ts.n_features)
  57: 
  58:     rows = []
  59:     keys = list(GRID.keys())
  60:     combos = list(itertools.product(*[GRID[k] for k in keys]))
  61:     global _TS, _MK
  62:     _TS, _MK = ts, model_kwargs
  63:     items = [dict(zip(keys, combo)) for combo in combos]
  64:     jobs = get_jobs()
  65:     print(f"Running {len(items)} hyperparameter combinations on STIN "
  66:           f"(MLP, method=full, val_frac={VAL_FRAC}); {describe(jobs)}")
  67:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
  68:     rows = []
  69:     for i, row in enumerate(parallel_map(_run_combo, items, jobs=jobs), 1):
  70:         rows.append(row)
  71:         if i % 20 == 0 or i == len(items):
  72:             print(f"  {i}/{len(items)} done ({time.perf_counter()-t0:.1f}s elapsed)")
  73: 
  74:     res = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("score", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
  75:     res.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "hparam_sweep_stin.csv"), index=False)
  76: 
  77:     best = res.iloc[0].to_dict()
  78:     best_hparams = {k: (int(best[k]) if k == "buffer_capacity" else float(best[k])) for k in keys}
  79:     with open(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams.json"), "w") as f:
  80:         json.dump(best_hparams, f, indent=2)
  81: 
  82:     print("\nTop 5 configurations:")
  83:     print(res.head(5).to_string(index=False))
  84:     print("\nSelected optimal hyperparameters (frozen for all further experiments):")
  85:     print(json.dumps(best_hparams, indent=2))
  86:     print(f"\nTotal sweep time: {time.perf_counter()-t0:.1f}s")
  87: 
  88: 
  89: if __name__ == "__main__":
  90:     main()


================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_leakage_ablation.py (5.3 KB)

   1: """Feature-provenance ablation for the random-split leakage claim.
   2: 
   3: CuCD-ID contains CCSDS identifiers, a circular time field, and 20-second
   4: sliding-window aggregates. A random row split can share overlapping windows
   5: between train and test, so a model may exploit aggregate/identifier shortcuts.
   6: This ablation RETRAINS the model after removing feature groups (unlike the
   7: test-time `nowindow` corruption in run_robustness.py) and reports the change
   8: in pooled accuracy and Macro-F1.
   9: 
  10: Protocol: CuCD-ID / MLP, frozen per-method/arch hyperparameters, 15 seeds,
  11: same random split and budgets as the main matrix. Variants:
  12:   all                 - all 22 features (main-matrix reference)
  13:   no_time             - drop TimeRadians
  14:   no_ids              - drop MsgId, CmdCode, ApId
  15:   no_window           - drop FlowLengthInWindow, SlidingWindow*, *InWindow
  16:   no_time_ids_window  - drop all three groups
  17: 
  18: Writes: results/leakage_ablation.csv and results/leakage_ablation_summary.csv
  19: """
  20: import sys
  21: import os
  22: import time
  23: 
  24: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  25: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  26: 
  27: from parallel import configure_single_thread, describe, parallel_map, get_jobs
  28: configure_single_thread()
  29: 
  30: import numpy as np
  31: import pandas as pd
  32: 
  33: import data_utils as du
  34: from train import train_continual
  35: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics, compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc
  36: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  37:                     BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, SEEDS, VAL_FRAC,
  38:                     load_frozen_hparams_strict)
  39: 
  40: METHODS = ["replay", "bic", "joint_scratch"]
  41: 
  42: ID_COLS = ["MsgId", "CmdCode", "ApId"]
  43: WINDOW_COLS = [
  44:     "FlowLengthInWindow",
  45:     "SlidingWindowMeanIntervalSec",
  46:     "SlidingWindowMaxIntervalSec",
  47:     "SlidingWindowMinIntervalSec",
  48:     "MessageCountInWindow",
  49:     "UniqueMessageIDsInWindow",
  50:     "AverageMessageLengthInWindow",
  51:     "MessageRateInWindow",
  52:     "StdDevMessageLengthInWindow",
  53: ]
  54: 
  55: VARIANTS = {
  56:     "all": [],
  57:     "no_time": ["TimeRadians"],
  58:     "no_ids": ID_COLS,
  59:     "no_window": WINDOW_COLS,
  60:     "no_time_ids_window": ["TimeRadians"] + ID_COLS + WINDOW_COLS,
  61: }
  62: 
  63: 
  64: _FROZEN = None
  65: _TS = {}
  66: 
  67: 
  68: def _run_one(item):
  69:     variant, method, seed = item
  70:     ts = _TS[(variant, seed)]
  71:     mk = model_kwargs_for("MLP", ts.n_features)
  72:     hp_method = _FROZEN.get("MLP", {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  73:     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **hp_method}
  74:     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES["MLP"], mk, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  75:     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
  76:     mf_ba = compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc(
  77:         out["model"], ts, out.get("corrector"))
  78:     drop_cols = VARIANTS[variant]
  79:     return dict(
  80:         variant=variant,
  81:         dropped_features="|".join(drop_cols) if drop_cols else "",
  82:         n_features=ts.n_features,
  83:         method=method, seed=seed,
  84:         **m, **mf_ba)
  85: 
  86: 
  87: def main():
  88:     global _FROZEN, _TS
  89:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
  90:     _FROZEN = load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  91:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(
  92:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  93:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"),
  94:     )
  95: 
  96:     for variant, drop_cols in VARIANTS.items():
  97:         missing = [c for c in drop_cols if c not in cucd_df.columns]
  98:         if missing:
  99:             raise KeyError(f"Leakage ablation: columns not found: {missing}")
 100:         df_variant = cucd_df.drop(columns=drop_cols)
 101:         for seed in SEEDS:
 102:             _TS[(variant, seed)] = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(
 103:                 df_variant, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
 104: 
 105:     items = [(variant, method, seed)
 106:              for variant in VARIANTS
 107:              for method in METHODS
 108:              for seed in SEEDS]
 109:     jobs = get_jobs()
 110:     print(f"Leakage ablation: {len(items)} runs; {describe(jobs)}")
 111:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
 112:     rows = []
 113:     for i, row in enumerate(parallel_map(_run_one, items, jobs=jobs), 1):
 114:         rows.append(row)
 115:         if i % 10 == 0 or i == len(items):
 116:             print(f"  [{i}/{len(items)}] {row['variant']} {row['method']} "
 117:                   f"seed={row['seed']} ACC={row['ACC']:.3f} "
 118:                   f"F1={row['MacroF1']:.3f} ({time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
 119: 
 120:     df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
 121:     df.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "leakage_ablation.csv"), index=False)
 122: 
 123:     summary = df.groupby(["variant", "method"]).agg(
 124:         n_features=("n_features", "first"),
 125:         ACC_mean=("ACC", "mean"), ACC_std=("ACC", "std"),
 126:         MacroF1_mean=("MacroF1", "mean"), MacroF1_std=("MacroF1", "std"),
 127:         BWT_mean=("BWT", "mean"), FM_mean=("FM", "mean"),
 128:     ).reset_index()
 129:     baseline = summary[summary.variant == "all"].set_index("method")
 130:     for metric in ["ACC_mean", "MacroF1_mean"]:
 131:         summary[f"{metric}_delta_vs_all"] = summary.apply(
 132:             lambda r: r[metric] - baseline.loc[r["method"], metric], axis=1)
 133:     summary.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "leakage_ablation_summary.csv"),
 134:                    index=False)
 135: 
 136:     print("\nMean pooled ACC / Macro-F1 by variant and method:")
 137:     print(summary[["variant", "method", "n_features", "ACC_mean",
 138:                    "MacroF1_mean", "ACC_mean_delta_vs_all",
 139:                    "MacroF1_mean_delta_vs_all"]].round(4).to_string(index=False))
 140:     print(f"\nWrote results/leakage_ablation.csv ({len(df)} runs, "
 141:           f"{time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
 142: 
 143: 
 144: if __name__ == "__main__":
 145:     main()

   1: """Main experiment matrix (Phase 1), confirmatory protocol.
   2: 
   3: 2 datasets x 3 architectures x 9 methods x 15 seeds = 810 runs.
   4: Hyperparameters are frozen from nested validation tuning; the validation pool
   5: is split into disjoint calibration (BiC/EWC fitting) and selection
   6: (hyperparameter scoring) halves.  Test data is never used for selection.
   7: 
   8: Writes:

  10:   results/main_results_summary.csv
  11:   results/accuracy_matrices.json
  12: """

  20: 
  21: from parallel import configure_single_thread, describe, parallel_map, get_jobs
  22: configure_single_thread()
  23: 
  24: import numpy as np
  25: import pandas as pd

  27: import data_utils as du
  28: from train import train_continual
  29: from metrics import (compute_cl_metrics, compute_detection_metrics,
  30:                      compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc,
  31:                      model_persistent_footprint, model_peak_training_ram,
  32:                      estimate_macs_per_sample, estimate_macs_per_update)
  33: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, ARCHS, METHODS, SEEDS, model_kwargs_for,
  34:                     DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR, BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS,
  35:                     load_frozen_hparams_strict, VAL_FRAC, VAL_CAP_PER_CLASS)
  36: 
  37: DATASETS = ["CuCD-ID", "STIN"]
  38: CALIB_METHODS = {"ewc", "full", "bic"}
  39: _FROZEN = None
  40: _DATASETS = {}

  42: 
  43: def final_detection_metrics(ts, out):
  44:     """CuCD-ID only: 1-p(normal) detector on the final all-task test pool."""
  45:     if ts.dataset_name != "CuCD-ID":
  46:         return {"DET_AUROC": float("nan"), "DET_AUPR": float("nan"),
  47:                 "DET_FPR95": float("nan"), "DET_PREV": float("nan")}
  48:     try:
  49:         normal_idx = list(ts.class_names_global).index("normal")
  50:     except ValueError:
  51:         return {"DET_AUROC": float("nan"), "DET_AUPR": float("nan"),
  52:                 "DET_FPR95": float("nan"), "DET_PREV": float("nan")}
  53:     Xs, ys, off = [], [], 0
  54:     for task in ts.tasks:
  55:         Xs.append(task.X_test)
  56:         ys.append(task.y_test + off)
  57:         off += task.n_new_classes
  58:     X_all = np.concatenate(Xs, axis=0)
  59:     y_all = np.concatenate(ys, axis=0)
  60:     logits, _ = out["model"].forward(X_all)
  61:     corr = out.get("corrector")
  62:     if corr is not None and getattr(corr, "fitted", False):
  63:         logits = corr.apply(logits)
  64:     return compute_detection_metrics(y_all, logits, normal_idx)
  65: 
  66: 
  67: def load_frozen_hparams():
  68:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  69:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  70: 
  71: 
  72: def build_datasets():
  73:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(
  74:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  75:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
  76:     stin_df = du.load_stin(
  77:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "SAT20.csv"),
  78:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "TER20.csv"))
  79:     datasets = {}
  80:     for seed in SEEDS:
  81:         datasets[("CuCD-ID", seed)] = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(
  82:             cucd_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC,
  83:             val_cap_per_class=VAL_CAP_PER_CLASS)
  84:         datasets[("STIN", seed)] = du.build_stin_tasks(
  85:             stin_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC,
  86:             val_cap_per_class=VAL_CAP_PER_CLASS)
  87:     return datasets
  88: 
  89: 
  90: def _run_one(item):
  91:     dset_name, arch, method, seed = item
  92:     ts = _DATASETS[(dset_name, seed)]
  93:     model_kwargs = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  94:     arch_hparams = _FROZEN.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  95:     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **arch_hparams}
  96: 
  97:     out = train_continual(
  98:         MODEL_CLASSES[arch], model_kwargs, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  99:     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
 100:     det = final_detection_metrics(ts, out)
 101:     mf_ba = compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc(
 102:         out["model"], ts, out.get("corrector"))
 103:     persist = model_persistent_footprint(
 104:         out["model"], out["buffer"], out["ewc"])
 105: 
 106:     if out["buffer"] is not None:
 107:         n_replay_step = max(
 108:             1, int(hp["batch_size"] * hp.get("replay_frac", 0.0)))
 109:     else:
 110:         n_replay_step = 0
 111: 
 112:     # Onboard update state: calibration halves are retained across task
 113:     # boundaries for methods that fit BiC / EWC Fisher.  The selection half is
 114:     # an experimental scoring artifact and is deliberately excluded.
 115:     retained_val_bytes = 0
 116:     if method in CALIB_METHODS:
 117:         for _task in ts.tasks:
 118:             if _task.X_calib is not None:
 119:                 retained_val_bytes += int(_task.X_calib.nbytes)
 120:             if _task.y_calib is not None:
 121:                 retained_val_bytes += int(_task.y_calib.nbytes)
 122: 
 123:     peak = model_peak_training_ram(
 124:         out["model"], out["buffer"], out["ewc"],
 125:         teacher=out.get("teacher"), batch_size=hp["batch_size"],
 126:         n_features=ts.n_features, n_replay=n_replay_step,
 127:         retained_state_bytes=retained_val_bytes)
 128: 
 129:     macs_fwd = estimate_macs_per_sample(out["model"], ts.n_features)
 130:     macs_update = int(
 131:         macs_fwd * 3 * int(out.get("train_samples_total", 0))
 132:         + macs_fwd * int(out.get("teacher_samples_total", 0)))
 133: 
 134:     row = dict(
 135:         dataset=dset_name, arch=arch, method=method, seed=seed,
 136:         n_tasks=len(ts.tasks), **m, **det, **mf_ba,
 137:         train_seconds_total=float(sum(out["per_task_train_seconds"])),
 138:         train_seconds_per_task=float(np.mean(out["per_task_train_seconds"])),
 139:         **persist,
 140:         peak_total_KB=peak["peak_total_KB"],
 141:         peak_adam_KB=peak["peak_adam_bytes_fp32"] / 1024.0,
 142:         retained_val_KB=retained_val_bytes / 1024.0,
 143:         macs_per_forward=macs_fwd,
 144:         macs_per_update=macs_update,
 145:     )
 146:     return row, out["R"].tolist()
 147: 
 148: 
 149: def main():
 150:     global _FROZEN, _DATASETS
 151:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
 152:     _FROZEN = load_frozen_hparams()
 153:     _DATASETS = build_datasets()
 154:     print("Using nested-validation frozen hyperparameters")
 155:     print(f"Validation protocol: {VAL_FRAC:.0%} total, split 50/50 into "
 156:           "disjoint calibration and selection halves")
 157: 
 158:     items = [(dset, arch, method, seed)
 159:              for dset in DATASETS
 160:              for arch in ARCHS
 161:              for method in METHODS
 162:              for seed in SEEDS]
 163:     jobs = get_jobs()
 164:     print(f"Main matrix: {len(items)} runs; {describe(jobs)}")
 165: 
 166:     run_rows = []
 167:     matrices = {}
 168:     t_start = time.perf_counter()
 169:     for i, (row, matrix) in enumerate(
 170:             parallel_map(_run_one, items, jobs=jobs), 1):
 171:         run_rows.append(row)
 172:         matrices[f"{row['dataset']}|{row['arch']}|{row['method']}|{row['seed']}"] = matrix
 173:         if i % 10 == 0 or i == len(items):
 174:             print(f"  [{i}/{len(items)}] {row['dataset']} {row['arch']} "
 175:                   f"{row['method']} seed={row['seed']} ACC={row['ACC']:.3f} "
 176:                   f"BWT={row['BWT']:.3f} ({time.perf_counter()-t_start:.1f}s)")
 177: 
 178:     runs_df = pd.DataFrame(run_rows)
 179:     runs_df.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "main_results_runs.csv"), index=False)
 180: 
 181:     summary = runs_df.groupby(["dataset", "arch", "method"]).agg(
 182:         ACC_mean=("ACC", "mean"), ACC_std=("ACC", "std"),
 183:         BWT_mean=("BWT", "mean"), BWT_std=("BWT", "std"),
 184:         FM_mean=("FM", "mean"), FM_std=("FM", "std"),
 185:         MacroF1_mean=("MacroF1", "mean"), MacroF1_std=("MacroF1", "std"),
 186:         BalancedAccuracy_mean=("BalancedAccuracy", "mean"),
 187:         BalancedAccuracy_std=("BalancedAccuracy", "std"),
 188:         DET_AUROC_mean=("DET_AUROC", "mean"), DET_AUROC_std=("DET_AUROC", "std"),
 189:         DET_AUPR_mean=("DET_AUPR", "mean"),

================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_per_class_analysis.py (5.9 KB)
================================================================================
   1: """
   2: Per-class precision/recall/F1 and confusion-matrix analysis.
   3: 
   4: The main experiment matrix (run_main.py) reports task-level ACC/BWT/FM,
   5: which only *imply* that old classes get forgotten under naive fine-tuning.
   6: This script makes that failure mode directly visible at the level of
   7: individual attack classes: for a small set of representative configs, the
   8: final trained model is evaluated on the full (all-tasks-seen) test set and
   9: a per-class precision/recall/F1 breakdown + confusion matrix is computed.
  10: 
  11: Configs analysed (15 seeds each, frozen per-method/arch hyperparameters):
  12:   * STIN,    GRU -- across all 9 methods (the secondary/stress-test dataset).
  13:   * CuCD-ID, MLP -- across all 9 methods (the primary dataset's
  14:     best-performing architecture, for a second, cleaner illustration).
  15: 
  16: Writes:
  17:   results/per_class_f1_runs.csv       (one row per class x method x seed)
  18:   results/per_class_f1_summary.csv    (mean over seeds)
  19:   results/confusion_matrices.json     (per (dataset,arch,method,seed) confusion matrix)
  20: """
  21: import sys, os, json
  22: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  23: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  24: 
  25: from parallel import configure_single_thread, describe, parallel_map, get_jobs
  26: configure_single_thread()
  27: 
  28: import numpy as np
  29: import pandas as pd
  30: 
  31: import data_utils as du
  32: from train import train_continual
  33: from metrics import per_class_prf1
  34: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  35:                     METHODS, SEEDS, BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, VAL_FRAC)
  36: 
  37: 
  38: def load_frozen_hparams():
  39:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  40:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  41:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  42: 
  43: 
  44: def evaluate_final_model_all_classes(model, task_seq, corrector=None):
  45:     """Recomputes the same class_offset resolution train.py uses (canonical
  46:     task order), builds the full concatenated test set across every task,
  47:     and returns (y_true_global, y_pred_global, class_names_in_global_order,
  48:     task_name_per_global_class). Applies the BiC corrector when fitted."""
  49:     class_offset = 0
  50:     Xs, ys = [], []
  51:     task_of_class = []
  52:     for task in task_seq.tasks:
  53:         y_test_global = task.y_test + class_offset
  54:         Xs.append(task.X_test)
  55:         ys.append(y_test_global)
  56:         task_of_class.extend([task.name] * task.n_new_classes)
  57:         class_offset += task.n_new_classes
  58:     X_all = np.concatenate(Xs, axis=0)
  59:     y_all = np.concatenate(ys, axis=0)
  60:     logits, _ = model.forward(X_all)
  61:     if corrector is not None and getattr(corrector, "fitted", False):
  62:         logits = corrector.apply(logits)
  63:     preds = logits.argmax(axis=1)
  64:     return y_all, preds, task_seq.class_names_global, task_of_class
  65: 
  66: 
  67: _FROZEN = None
  68: _TS = {}
  69: 
  70: 
  71: def _run_one(item):
  72:     dataset_name, arch, method, seed = item
  73:     ts = _TS[(dataset_name, seed)]
  74:     mk = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  75:     arch_hparams = _FROZEN.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  76:     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **arch_hparams}
  77:     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], mk, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  78:     y_true, y_pred, class_names, task_of_class = evaluate_final_model_all_classes(
  79:         out["model"], ts, out.get("corrector"))
  80:     report = per_class_prf1(y_true, y_pred, len(class_names))
  81:     class_rows = []
  82:     for c, cname in enumerate(class_names):
  83:         class_rows.append(dict(
  84:             dataset=dataset_name, arch=arch, method=method, seed=seed,
  85:             class_id=c, class_name=cname, task_name=task_of_class[c],

  89:     key = f"{dataset_name}|{arch}|{method}|{seed}"
  90:     cm = {
