 666: 
 667: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
 668: # Phase 0: temporal (leakage-safe) builders.
 669: # Why: CuCD-ID features contain SlidingWindow*/InWindow aggregates over
 670: # neighbouring rows, so a random row-shuffle leaks correlated windows across
 671: # train/val/test and inflates absolute ACC. These builders sort each class by
 672: # time (CuCD-ID: TimeRadians; STIN: file/row order as proxy) and cut
 673: # contiguous [train | val | test-future] blocks. Budgets/scaler/test-frac
 674: # semantics are otherwise identical to the random builders, so a
 675: # random-vs-temporal comparison isolates leakage.
 676: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
 677: def _ordered_idx_cucd(df: pd.DataFrame, mask) -> np.ndarray:
 678:     sub = df.loc[mask]
 679:     if "TimeRadians" in df.columns:
 680:         sub, _ = _chronological_order(sub, time_col="TimeRadians")
 681:     return sub.index.to_numpy()
 682: 
 683: 
 684: def build_cucd_id_tasks_temporal(
 685:     df: pd.DataFrame,
 686:     seed: int = 0,
 687:     test_frac: float = 0.30,
 688:     initial_n_per_class: int = 700,
 689:     uplink_n_per_class: int = 150,
 690:     val_frac: float = 0.20,
 691:     val_cap_per_class: int = 300,
 692: ) -> TaskSequence:
 693:     rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
 694:     feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ("Label", "label_name")]
 695:     tasks, class_names_global = [], []
 696:     scaler_mean = scaler_std = None
 697:     for t, (tname, class_list) in enumerate(CUCD_TASK_DEFS):
 698:         n_per_class = initial_n_per_class if t == 0 else uplink_n_per_class
 699:         Xs_train, ys_train, Xs_test, ys_test, Xs_val, ys_val = [], [], [], [], [], []
 700:         for local_c, lbl in enumerate(class_list):
 701:             class_names_global.append(lbl)
 702:             idx_sorted = _ordered_idx_cucd(df, df["label_name"] == lbl)
 703:             train_pool, val_pool, test_idx = _temporal_block_split(idx_sorted, test_frac, val_frac)
 704:             # Train budget: earliest block (draw deterministically: head of block,
 705:             # so temporal order is preserved in expectation; shuffle only within batch later).
 706:             train_idx = train_pool[:n_per_class] if len(train_pool) > n_per_class else train_pool
 707:             val_idx = val_pool[:val_cap_per_class]
 708:             Xs_train.append(df.loc[train_idx, feature_cols].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))
 709:             ys_train.append(np.full(len(train_idx), local_c, dtype=np.int64))
 710:             Xs_test.append(df.loc[test_idx, feature_cols].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))
 711:             ys_test.append(np.full(len(test_idx), local_c, dtype=np.int64))
 712:             if len(val_idx):
 713:                 Xs_val.append(df.loc[val_idx, feature_cols].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))
 714:                 ys_val.append(np.full(len(val_idx), local_c, dtype=np.int64))
 715:         X_train = np.concatenate(Xs_train, axis=0)
 716:         y_train = np.concatenate(ys_train, axis=0)
 717:         X_test = np.concatenate(Xs_test, axis=0)
 718:         y_test = np.concatenate(ys_test, axis=0)
 719:         X_val = np.concatenate(Xs_val, axis=0) if Xs_val else None
 720:         y_val = np.concatenate(ys_val, axis=0) if ys_val else None
 721:         if t == 0:
 722:             scaler_mean, scaler_std = _fit_scaler(X_train)
 723:         X_train = _apply_scaler(X_train, scaler_mean, scaler_std)
 724:         X_test = _apply_scaler(X_test, scaler_mean, scaler_std)
 725:         if X_val is not None:
 726:             X_val = _apply_scaler(X_val, scaler_mean, scaler_std)

 795: def build_cucd_id_tasks_purged_temporal(
 796:     df: pd.DataFrame,
 797:     seed: int = 0,
 798:     test_frac: float = 0.30,
 799:     initial_n_per_class: int = 700,
 800:     uplink_n_per_class: int = 150,
 801:     val_frac: float = 0.20,
 802:     val_cap_per_class: int = 300,
 803:     purge_time_rad: float = 0.02,
 804:     feature_drop=None,
 805: ) -> TaskSequence:
 806:     """Leakage-safe temporal split with purge gaps on TimeRadians.
 807:     Layout per class: [train_pool | purge | val | purge | test]
 808:     The purge gaps use TimeRadians units (0.02 rad ≈ 22s equivalent)
 809:     to exceed the 20-second sliding-window feature horizon
 810:     and the documented 20-22s window-clearing pauses in CuCD-ID."""
 811:     import warnings
 812:     rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
 813:     drop = set(feature_drop or [])
 814:     feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns
 815:                     if c not in ("Label", "label_name") and c not in drop]
 816:     tasks, class_names_global = [], []
 817:     scaler_mean = scaler_std = None
 818:     for t, (tname, class_list) in enumerate(CUCD_TASK_DEFS):
 819:         n_per_class = initial_n_per_class if t == 0 else uplink_n_per_class
 820:         Xs_train, ys_train, Xs_test, ys_test, Xs_val, ys_val = [], [], [], [], [], []
 821:         for local_c, lbl in enumerate(class_list):
 822:             class_names_global.append(lbl)
 823:             mask = df["label_name"] == lbl
 824:             train_pool, val_pool, test_idx = _temporal_purged_split(
 825:                 df, mask, test_frac, val_frac, purge_time_rad, time_col="TimeRadians")
 826:             # Train budget: earliest block (deterministic head)
 827:             train_idx = train_pool[:n_per_class] if len(train_pool) > n_per_class else train_pool
 828:             if len(train_idx) == 0:
 829:                 raise ValueError(
 830:                     f"Purged temporal split emptied train for class '{lbl}' "
 831:                     f"(task {tname}, seed={seed}, purge_time_rad={purge_time_rad}). "
 832:                     "Reduce the purge or check the class TimeRadians span.")
 833:             if len(test_idx) == 0:
 834:                 raise ValueError(
 835:                     f"Purged temporal split emptied test for class '{lbl}' "
 836:                     f"(task {tname}, seed={seed}).")
 837:             val_idx = val_pool[:val_cap_per_class]
 838:             if val_frac > 0 and len(val_idx) == 0:
 839:                 warnings.warn(
 840:                     f"Purged temporal split emptied val for class '{lbl}' "
 841:                     f"(task {tname}, seed={seed}, purge_time_rad={purge_time_rad}); "
 842:                     "BiC/val-Fisher lose this class. Narrow TimeRadians span suspected.")
 843:             Xs_train.append(df.loc[train_idx, feature_cols].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))
 844:             ys_train.append(np.full(len(train_idx), local_c, dtype=np.int64))
 845:             Xs_test.append(df.loc[test_idx, feature_cols].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))
 846:             ys_test.append(np.full(len(test_idx), local_c, dtype=np.int64))
 847:             if len(val_idx):
 848:                 Xs_val.append(df.loc[val_idx, feature_cols].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))
 849:                 ys_val.append(np.full(len(val_idx), local_c, dtype=np.int64))
 850:         X_train = np.concatenate(Xs_train, axis=0)
 851:         y_train = np.concatenate(ys_train, axis=0)
 852:         X_test = np.concatenate(Xs_test, axis=0)
 853:         y_test = np.concatenate(ys_test, axis=0)
 854:         X_val = np.concatenate(Xs_val, axis=0) if Xs_val else None
 855:         y_val = np.concatenate(ys_val, axis=0) if ys_val else None
 856:         if t == 0:
 857:             scaler_mean, scaler_std = _fit_scaler(X_train)
 858:         X_train = _apply_scaler(X_train, scaler_mean, scaler_std)
 859:         X_test = _apply_scaler(X_test, scaler_mean, scaler_std)
 860:         if X_val is not None:
 861:             X_val = _apply_scaler(X_val, scaler_mean, scaler_std)
 862:         perm = rng.permutation(len(X_train))
 863:         X_train, y_train = X_train[perm], y_train[perm]
 864:         tasks.append(Task(task_id=t, name=tname, class_names=class_list,
 865:                           X_train=X_train, y_train=y_train, X_test=X_test, y_test=y_test,
 866:                           X_val=X_val, y_val=y_val))
 867:     _assert_split_integrity(tasks)
 868:     return TaskSequence("CuCD-ID", tasks, feature_cols, scaler_mean, scaler_std,
 869:                         class_names_global, split_mode="temporal_purged", val_frac=val_frac)

FILE: ./src/losses.py (0.5 KB)

   1: import numpy as np
   2: 
   3: 
   4: def softmax_cross_entropy(logits: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray):
   5:     """logits: (N,C) ; y: (N,) int labels. Returns (loss_scalar_mean, dlogits, probs)."""
   6:     z = logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
   7:     exp = np.exp(z)
   8:     probs = exp / exp.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
   9:     N = logits.shape[0]
  10:     logp = -np.log(np.clip(probs[np.arange(N), y], 1e-12, None))
  11:     loss = logp.mean()
  12:     dlogits = probs.copy()
  13:     dlogits[np.arange(N), y] -= 1
  14:     dlogits /= N
  15:     return loss, dlogits, probs

FILE: ./src/metrics.py (15.9 KB)

   1: """Standard continual-learning metrics computed from an accuracy matrix R,
   2: where R[i, j] = test accuracy on task j immediately after finishing training
   3: on task i (only defined for j <= i). NaN elsewhere.
   4: 
   5:   ACC  -- average accuracy across all tasks after learning the final task.
   6:   BWT  -- backward transfer (Lopez-Paz & Ranzato, 2017). Negative = forgetting.
   7:   FM   -- forgetting measure (Chaudhry et al., 2018): average of the largest
   8:           drop from a task's peak accuracy to its final accuracy.
   9: 
  10: Also provides a per-class confusion matrix / precision / recall / F1
  11: breakdown (`confusion_matrix`, `per_class_prf1`) for the final trained
  12: model. ACC/BWT/FM are task-level aggregates; the per-class breakdown makes
  13: the same "old classes forgotten" phenomenon visible at the level of
  14: individual attack types -- e.g. showing an old class's F1 collapse to ~0
  15: under naive fine-tuning even though the task-level ACC number alone only
  16: implies it indirectly.
  17: """
  18: import numpy as np
  19: 
  20: 
  21: def compute_cl_metrics(R: np.ndarray):
  22:     T = R.shape[0]
  23:     final_row = R[T - 1]
  24:     acc = float(np.nanmean(final_row))
  25: 
  26:     if T > 1:
  27:         bwt_terms = [R[T - 1, j] - R[j, j] for j in range(T - 1)]
  28:         bwt = float(np.mean(bwt_terms))
  29: 
  30:         fm_terms = []
  31:         for j in range(T - 1):
  32:             peak = np.nanmax(R[j:T - 1, j]) if T - 1 > j else R[j, j]
  33:             fm_terms.append(peak - R[T - 1, j])
  34:         fm = float(np.mean(fm_terms))
  35:     else:
  36:         bwt = 0.0
  37:         fm = 0.0
  38: 
  39:     return {"ACC": acc, "BWT": bwt, "FM": fm}
  40: 
  41: 
  42: def compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc(model, task_seq, corrector=None):
  43:     """Compute Macro-F1 and Balanced Accuracy on the final model's test predictions.
  44:     Evaluates on the concatenated test sets of all tasks seen so far.
  45:     Applies the BiC corrector when fitted (same as detection/per-class eval)."""
  46:     Xs, ys, off = [], [], 0
  47:     for task in task_seq.tasks:
  48:         Xs.append(task.X_test)
  49:         ys.append(task.y_test + off)
  50:         off += task.n_new_classes
  51:     X_all = np.concatenate(Xs, axis=0)
  52:     y_all = np.concatenate(ys, axis=0)
  53: 
  54:     logits, _ = model.forward(X_all)
  55:     if corrector is not None and getattr(corrector, "fitted", False):
  56:         logits = corrector.apply(logits)
  57:     y_pred = logits.argmax(axis=1)
  58:     n_classes = len(task_seq.class_names_global)
  59: 
  60:     # Per-class metrics
  61:     cm = confusion_matrix(y_all, y_pred, n_classes)
  62:     tp = np.diag(cm).astype(float)
  63:     fp = cm.sum(axis=0).astype(float) - tp
  64:     fn = cm.sum(axis=1).astype(float) - tp
  65: 
  66:     precision = np.divide(tp, tp + fp, out=np.zeros_like(tp), where=(tp + fp) > 0)
  67:     recall = np.divide(tp, tp + fn, out=np.zeros_like(tp), where=(tp + fn) > 0)
  68:     f1 = np.divide(2 * precision * recall, precision + recall,
  69:                     out=np.zeros_like(tp), where=(precision + recall) > 0)
  70: 
  71:     macro_f1 = float(np.mean(f1))
  72: 
  73:     # Balanced Accuracy = mean recall per class
  74:     bal_acc = float(np.mean(recall))
  75: 
  76:     return {"MacroF1": macro_f1, "BalancedAccuracy": bal_acc}
  77: 
  78: 
  79: def confusion_matrix(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray, n_classes: int) -> np.ndarray:
  80:     """cm[i, j] = number of true-class-i samples predicted as class j."""
  81:     cm = np.zeros((n_classes, n_classes), dtype=np.int64)
  82:     np.add.at(cm, (y_true, y_pred), 1)
  83:     return cm
  84: 
  85: 
  86: def per_class_prf1(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray, n_classes: int) -> dict:
  87:     """Per-class precision / recall / F1 / support, computed from a
  88:     confusion matrix (no sklearn dependency -- consistent with the rest of
  89:     this from-scratch pipeline). Classes with zero predicted or zero true
  90:     samples get precision/recall/F1 = 0 rather than NaN, so per-class bar
  91:     charts render cleanly (a class the model never predicts, or that never
  92:     appears in this test slice, genuinely has zero recall/precision)."""
  93:     cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred, n_classes)
  94:     tp = np.diag(cm).astype(float)
  95:     fp = cm.sum(axis=0).astype(float) - tp
  96:     fn = cm.sum(axis=1).astype(float) - tp
  97:     precision = np.divide(tp, tp + fp, out=np.zeros_like(tp), where=(tp + fp) > 0)
  98:     recall = np.divide(tp, tp + fn, out=np.zeros_like(tp), where=(tp + fn) > 0)
  99:     f1 = np.divide(2 * precision * recall, precision + recall,
 100:                     out=np.zeros_like(tp), where=(precision + recall) > 0)
 101:     support = cm.sum(axis=1)
 102:     return {"precision": precision, "recall": recall, "f1": f1,
 103:             "support": support, "confusion_matrix": cm}

 106: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
 107: # Phase 1: binary detection metrics (normal-vs-attack) + from-scratch stats.
 108: # CuCD-ID has a `normal` class, so a multiclass CIL head also implies a
 109: # detector: score = 1 - p(normal). STIN has no benign class and must NOT use
 110: # these (callers should guard on dataset name). No sklearn/scipy: all ranks,
 111: # curves and p-values below are hand-implemented in NumPy.
 112: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
 113: 
 114: def detection_scores_from_logits(logits: np.ndarray, normal_idx: int) -> np.ndarray:
 115:     """P(attack) = 1 - softmax(logits)[normal]. Higher => more attack-like."""
 116:     z = logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
 117:     exp = np.exp(z)
 118:     probs = exp / exp.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
 119:     return (1.0 - probs[:, normal_idx]).astype(np.float64)
 120: 
 121: 
 122: def _binary_auroc(y_bin: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray) -> float:
 123:     """Mann-Whitney U / rank formulation. Returns 0.5 on degenerate input."""
 124:     y_bin = np.asarray(y_bin).astype(int)
 125:     scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float64)
 126:     n_pos = int(y_bin.sum())
 127:     n_neg = len(y_bin) - n_pos
 128:     if n_pos == 0 or n_neg == 0:
 129:         return 0.5
 130:     order = np.argsort(scores, kind="mergesort")
 131:     ranks = np.empty(len(scores), dtype=np.float64)
 132:     # average ranks for ties
 133:     i = 0
 134:     while i < len(scores):
 135:         j = i
 136:         while j + 1 < len(scores) and scores[order[j + 1]] == scores[order[i]]:
 137:             j += 1
 138:         avg_rank = (i + j) / 2.0 + 1.0  # 1-based
 139:         ranks[order[i:j + 1]] = avg_rank
 140:         i = j + 1
 141:     rank_sum_pos = float(ranks[y_bin == 1].sum())
 142:     auc = (rank_sum_pos - n_pos * (n_pos + 1) / 2.0) / (n_pos * n_neg)
 143:     return float(np.clip(auc, 0.0, 1.0))
 144: 
 145: 
 146: def _binary_aupr(y_bin: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray) -> float:
 147:     """Average-precision (step-function PR-AUC). Baseline = prevalence."""
 148:     y_bin = np.asarray(y_bin).astype(int)
 149:     scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float64)
 150:     n_pos = int(y_bin.sum())
 151:     if n_pos == 0:
 152:         return 0.0
 153:     order = np.argsort(-scores, kind="mergesort")
 154:     ys = y_bin[order]
 155:     tp_cum = np.cumsum(ys)
 156:     precision = tp_cum / (np.arange(len(ys)) + 1.0)
 157:     recall = tp_cum / n_pos
 158:     # step integration over recall gains
 159:     ap = 0.0
 160:     prev_r = 0.0
 161:     for p, r in zip(precision, recall):
 162:         if r > prev_r:
 163:             ap += float(p) * float(r - prev_r)
 164:             prev_r = float(r)
 165:     return float(np.clip(ap, 0.0, 1.0))
 166: 
 167: 
 168: def _fpr_at_tpr(y_bin: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray, target_tpr: float = 0.95) -> float:
 169:     y_bin = np.asarray(y_bin).astype(int)
 170:     scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float64)
 171:     n_pos, n_neg = int(y_bin.sum()), int((1 - y_bin).sum())
 172:     if n_pos == 0 or n_neg == 0:
 173:         return float("nan")
 174:     order = np.argsort(-scores, kind="mergesort")
 175:     ys = y_bin[order]
 176:     tp_cum = np.cumsum(ys)
 177:     fp_cum = np.cumsum(1 - ys)
 178:     tpr = tp_cum / n_pos
 179:     fpr = fp_cum / n_neg
 180:     idx = np.flatnonzero(tpr >= target_tpr)
 181:     if len(idx) == 0:
 182:         return 1.0
 183:     return float(fpr[idx[0]])
 184: 
 185: 
 186: def compute_detection_metrics(y_true_global: np.ndarray, logits: np.ndarray,
 187:                               normal_global_idx: int) -> dict:
 188:     """Binary normal-vs-attack metrics from a multiclass head. Returns
 189:     AUROC / AUPR / FPR@95%TPR plus prevalence (for AUPR context)."""
 190:     y_bin = (np.asarray(y_true_global) != normal_global_idx).astype(int)
 191:     scores = detection_scores_from_logits(np.asarray(logits), int(normal_global_idx))
 192:     return {
 193:         "DET_AUROC": _binary_auroc(y_bin, scores),
 194:         "DET_AUPR": _binary_aupr(y_bin, scores),
 195:         "DET_FPR95": _fpr_at_tpr(y_bin, scores, 0.95),
 196:         "DET_PREV": float(y_bin.mean()) if len(y_bin) else float("nan"),
 197:     }
 198: 
 199: 
 200: def _normal_cdf(x: float) -> float:
 201:     import math
 202:     return 0.5 * (1.0 + math.erf(x / math.sqrt(2.0)))
 203: 
 204: 
 205: def wilcoxon_signed_rank(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> dict:
 206:     """Exact-ish Wilcoxon signed-rank for small n (normal approx, no scipy).
 207:     Returns W+, z, two-sided p. Zero differences are dropped; ties averaged."""
 208:     import math
 209:     x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
 210:     y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
 211:     d = x - y
 212:     d = d[d != 0]
 213:     n = len(d)
 214:     if n == 0:
 215:         return {"n": 0, "W": 0.0, "z": 0.0, "p_two_sided": 1.0}
 216:     absd = np.abs(d)
 217:     order = np.argsort(absd, kind="mergesort")
 218:     ranks = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float64)
 219:     i = 0
 220:     while i < n:
 221:         j = i
 222:         while j + 1 < n and absd[order[j + 1]] == absd[order[i]]:
 223:             j += 1
 224:         ranks[order[i:j + 1]] = (i + j) / 2.0 + 1.0
 225:         i = j + 1
 226:     w_pos = float(ranks[d > 0].sum())
 227:     mu = n * (n + 1) / 4.0
 228:     # tie correction
 229:     _, counts = np.unique(absd, return_counts=True)
 230:     tie = float(np.sum(counts ** 3 - counts) / 48.0)
 231:     var = n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1) / 24.0 - tie
 232:     if var <= 0:
 233:         return {"n": n, "W": w_pos, "z": 0.0, "p_two_sided": 1.0}
 234:     z = (w_pos - mu) / math.sqrt(var)
 235:     p = 2.0 * (1.0 - _normal_cdf(abs(z)))
 236:     return {"n": n, "W": w_pos, "z": float(z), "p_two_sided": float(np.clip(p, 0.0, 1.0))}
 237: 
 238: 
 239: def model_persistent_footprint(model, buffer=None, ewc=None):
 240:     """Persistent deployed storage footprint (what gets stored in Flash/EEPROM).
 241:     INT8 model weights + INT8 replay buffer + FP16 EWC."""
 242:     model_bytes = model.param_count() * 1  # INT8
 243:     buffer_bytes = buffer.memory_bytes(quantized=True) if buffer is not None else 0
 244:     ewc_bytes = ewc.memory_bytes(bytes_per_val=2) if ewc is not None else 0  # FP16
 245:     total = model_bytes + buffer_bytes + ewc_bytes
 246:     return {
 247:         "persistent_model_bytes_int8": model_bytes,
 248:         "persistent_buffer_bytes_int8": buffer_bytes,
 249:         "persistent_ewc_bytes_fp16": ewc_bytes,
 250:         "persistent_cmmu_bytes": buffer_bytes + ewc_bytes,
 251:         "persistent_total_bytes": total,
 252:         "persistent_total_KB": total / 1024.0,
 253:     }
 254: 
 255: 
 256: def model_peak_training_ram(model, buffer=None, ewc=None, teacher=None,
 257:                              batch_size: int = 32, n_features: int = 22,
 258:                              n_replay: int = 0, retained_state_bytes: int = 0):
 259:     """Estimated peak RAM during training (SRAM usage on MCU).
 260: 
 261:     FP32 weights + gradients + Adam states + *batch* activations + current
 262:     batch + replay batch + teacher + temp + any retained update-time state
 263:     (e.g. cumulative validation arrays used by EWC/BiC).
 264:     """
 265:     n_params = model.param_count()
 266: 
 267:     # FP32 model weights (4 bytes each)
 268:     weights_bytes = n_params * 4
 269: 
 270:     # Gradients (same size as weights, FP32)
 271:     gradients_bytes = n_params * 4
 272: 
 273:     # Adam optimizer states: m and v for each parameter (2 * 4 bytes each)
 274:     adam_bytes = n_params * 4 * 2  # m + v
 275: 
 276:     # Activations for the actual minibatch, FP32. The old batch=1 estimate
 277:     # understated GRU/CNN peak RAM by roughly the batch factor.
 278:     act_floats = _estimate_activation_floats(model, n_features)
 279:     activations_bytes = act_floats * 4 * int(batch_size)
 280: 
 281:     # Training batch (input + labels)
 282:     batch_bytes = batch_size * n_features * 4 + batch_size * 8
 283: 
 284:     # Replay batch (if applicable)
 285:     replay_batch_bytes = n_replay * n_features * 4 + n_replay * 8 if n_replay > 0 else 0
 286: 
 287:     # Teacher model (for distillation methods): weights + its minibatch
 288:     # activations. The teacher sees the replay-augmented batch.
 289:     if teacher is not None:
 290:         teacher_bytes = teacher.param_count() * 4
 291:         teacher_bytes += (_estimate_activation_floats(teacher, n_features)
 292:                           * 4 * int(batch_size + n_replay))
 293:     else:
 294:         teacher_bytes = 0
 295: 
 296:     # Temporary buffers (gradients, intermediate computations) ~2x weights
 297:     temp_bytes = n_params * 4 * 2
 298: 
 299:     peak_bytes = (weights_bytes + gradients_bytes + adam_bytes +
 300:                   activations_bytes + batch_bytes + replay_batch_bytes +
 301:                   teacher_bytes + temp_bytes)
 302: 
 303:     # Also include CMMU structures in FP32 during training
 304:     buffer_fp32 = buffer.memory_bytes(quantized=False) if buffer is not None else 0
 305:     ewc_fp32 = ewc.memory_bytes(bytes_per_val=4) if ewc is not None else 0
 306: 
 307:     peak_bytes += buffer_fp32 + ewc_fp32 + int(retained_state_bytes)
 308: 
 309:     return {
 310:         "peak_weights_bytes_fp32": weights_bytes,
 311:         "peak_gradients_bytes_fp32": gradients_bytes,
 312:         "peak_adam_bytes_fp32": adam_bytes,
 313:         "peak_activations_bytes_fp32": activations_bytes,
 314:         "peak_batch_bytes_fp32": batch_bytes,
 315:         "peak_replay_batch_bytes_fp32": replay_batch_bytes,
 316:         "peak_teacher_bytes_fp32": teacher_bytes,
 317:         "peak_temp_bytes_fp32": temp_bytes,
 318:         "peak_buffer_bytes_fp32": buffer_fp32,
 319:         "peak_ewc_bytes_fp32": ewc_fp32,
 320:         "peak_retained_state_bytes": int(retained_state_bytes),
 321:         "peak_total_bytes": peak_bytes,
 322:         "peak_total_KB": peak_bytes / 1024.0,
 323:     }
 324: 
 325: 
 326: def _estimate_activation_floats(model, n_features: int) -> int:
 327:     """Estimate FP32 activation count for batch=1 forward pass."""
 328:     name = model.NAME
 329:     if name == "MLP":
 330:         # W1: (F, h1) -> h1, W2: (h1, h2) -> h2, head: (h2, C) -> C
 331:         h1 = model.params["W1"].shape[1]
 332:         h2 = model.params["W2"].shape[1]
 333:         C = model.params["head.W"].shape[1] if "head.W" in model.params else 0
 334:         return h1 + h2 + C
 335:     if name == "GRU":
 336:         H = model.hidden
 337:         S = model.seq_len
 338:         # Per step: 3 gates * (H + H) + H hidden state
 339:         per_step = 3 * 2 * H + H
 340:         C = model.params["head.W"].shape[1] if "head.W" in model.params else 0
 341:         return per_step * S + C
 342:     if name == "CNN1D":
 343:         c1 = model.c1
 344:         c2 = model.c2
 345:         L = model.L
 346:         # Conv1: L * c1, Conv2: L * c2, head: C
 347:         C = model.params["head.W"].shape[1] if "head.W" in model.params else 0
 348:         return L * c1 + L * c2 + C
 349:     raise ValueError(name)
 350: 
 351: 
 352: def estimate_macs(model, n_features: int) -> int:
 353:     """Rough multiply-accumulate count for one forward pass (batch=1).
 354:     Includes the trunk plus the CURRENT width of the shared classification
 355:     head (head compute grows as more classes are learned -- unlike the
 356:     task-incremental multi-head design, only one head is ever active, but
 357:     its width is the total number of classes seen so far)."""
 358:     name = model.NAME
 359:     head_macs = model.params["head.W"].size if "head.W" in model.params else 0
 360:     if name == "MLP":
 361:         w1 = model.params["W1"]; w2 = model.params["W2"]
 362:         return int(w1.size + w2.size + head_macs)
 363:     if name == "GRU":
 364:         # 3 gates, each: x@W (F*H) + h@U (H*H), summed over seq_len timesteps
 365:         H = model.hidden
 366:         F = model.feat_per_step
 367:         per_step = 3 * (F * H + H * H)
 368:         return int(per_step * model.seq_len + head_macs)
 369:     if name == "CNN1D":
 370:         c1, c2, k = model.c1, model.c2, model.k
 371:         L = model.L
 372:         conv1 = L * c1 * 1 * k
 373:         conv2 = L * c2 * c1 * k
 374:         return int(conv1 + conv2 + head_macs)
 375:     raise ValueError(name)
 376: 
 377: 
 378: def estimate_macs_per_sample(model, n_features: int) -> int:
 379:     """MACs for one forward pass (batch=1)."""
 380:     return estimate_macs(model, n_features)
 381: 
 382: 
 383: def estimate_macs_per_update(model, n_features: int, n_train_samples: int,
 384:                               epochs: int, batch_size: int = 32) -> int:
 385:     """Estimated/conservative MACs for one training update.
 386:     Uses the final-head-width per-sample proxy for all tasks (earlier tasks
 387:     had fewer output classes, so this overestimates them); excludes replay
 388:     augmentation, teacher forwards, and val/BiC passes unless counted by
 389:     the caller via performed sample counters."""
 390:     macs_per_fwd = estimate_macs(model, n_features)
 391:     # Forward + backward ≈ 3x forward (gradient computation)
 392:     macs_per_sample = macs_per_fwd * 3
 393:     steps_per_epoch = max(1, n_train_samples // batch_size)
 394:     return macs_per_sample * steps_per_epoch * epochs

FILE: ./src/models.py (11.3 KB)

   1: """
   2: From-scratch (pure NumPy) implementations of three TinyML-sized backbones,
   3: each topped with a single, dynamically-growing shared classification head
   4: (class-incremental protocol: no task ID is available at train or test time;
   5: every sample is classified against the full set of classes learned so far
   6: through one shared softmax layer). When a new task introduces classes that
   7: have never been seen before, new output columns are appended to the shared
   8: head (existing columns/weights are preserved untouched).
   9: 
  10: No autograd framework is used -- every forward/backward pass is derived and
  11: implemented by hand, mirroring the kind of fixed-point / fixed-shape
  12: inference code that would eventually be hand-ported to C for an MCU
  13: (CMSIS-NN style). This also keeps the whole pipeline dependency-free (no
  14: PyTorch/TensorFlow available or needed).
  15: 
  16: All three models expose the same interface:
  17:     forward(X)                 -> logits, cache      (logits over ALL classes seen so far)
  18:     backward(cache, dlogits)   -> grads (dict[str, np.ndarray])
  19:     expand_head(n_new_classes) -> grows the shared output layer
  20:     trunk_dim
  21:     param_count()
  22: """
  23: from __future__ import annotations
  24: import numpy as np
  25: 
  26: 
  27: def relu(x):
  28:     return np.maximum(0, x)
  29: 
  30: 
  31: def relu_grad(x):
  32:     return (x > 0).astype(x.dtype)
  33: 
  34: 
  35: def sigmoid(x):
  36:     return 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(x, -30, 30)))
  37: 
  38: 
  39: class _BaseModel:
  40:     """Shared, dynamically-growing single classification head."""
  41: 
  42:     def __init__(self, trunk_dim: int, seed: int = 0, head_scale: float = 0.1):
  43:         self.trunk_dim = trunk_dim
  44:         self.params: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
  45:         self._rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
  46:         self._head_scale = head_scale
  47: 
  48:     # ---- shared growing head ---------------------------------------------
  49:     @property
  50:     def n_classes_total(self) -> int:
  51:         return self.params["head.W"].shape[1] if "head.W" in self.params else 0
  52: 
  53:     def expand_head(self, n_new_classes: int):
  54:         """Append n_new_classes new output columns to the shared head,
  55:         preserving all existing columns/weights untouched."""
  56:         if n_new_classes <= 0:
  57:             return
  58:         new_W = (self._rng.standard_normal((self.trunk_dim, n_new_classes)) * self._head_scale).astype(np.float32)
  59:         new_b = np.zeros(n_new_classes, dtype=np.float32)
  60:         if "head.W" not in self.params:
  61:             self.params["head.W"] = new_W
  62:             self.params["head.b"] = new_b
  63:         else:
  64:             self.params["head.W"] = np.concatenate([self.params["head.W"], new_W], axis=1)
  65:             self.params["head.b"] = np.concatenate([self.params["head.b"], new_b], axis=0)
  66: 
  67:     def forward(self, X: np.ndarray):
  68:         trunk_out, cache_trunk = self.forward_trunk(X)
  69:         logits = trunk_out @ self.params["head.W"] + self.params["head.b"]
  70:         cache = (cache_trunk, trunk_out)
  71:         return logits, cache
  72: 
  73:     def backward(self, cache, dlogits: np.ndarray):
  74:         cache_trunk, trunk_out = cache
  75:         grads = {}
  76:         grads["head.W"] = trunk_out.T @ dlogits
  77:         grads["head.b"] = dlogits.sum(axis=0)
  78:         dtrunk = dlogits @ self.params["head.W"].T
  79:         grads.update(self.backward_trunk(cache_trunk, dtrunk))
  80:         return grads
  81: 
  82:     def param_count(self) -> int:
  83:         return sum(v.size for v in self.params.values())
  84: 
  85:     # to be implemented by subclasses
  86:     def forward_trunk(self, X):
  87:         raise NotImplementedError
  88: 
  89:     def backward_trunk(self, cache, dtrunk):
  90:         raise NotImplementedError
  91: 
  92: 
  93: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
  94: # 1. MLP
  95: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
  96: class CubeSatMLP(_BaseModel):
  97:     NAME = "MLP"
  98: 
  99:     def __init__(self, input_dim: int, h1: int = 32, h2: int = 16, seed: int = 0):
 100:         super().__init__(trunk_dim=h2, seed=seed)
 101:         rng = self._rng
 102:         s1 = np.sqrt(2.0 / input_dim)
 103:         s2 = np.sqrt(2.0 / h1)
 104:         self.params["W1"] = (rng.standard_normal((input_dim, h1)) * s1).astype(np.float32)
 105:         self.params["b1"] = np.zeros(h1, dtype=np.float32)
 106:         self.params["W2"] = (rng.standard_normal((h1, h2)) * s2).astype(np.float32)
 107:         self.params["b2"] = np.zeros(h2, dtype=np.float32)
 108: 
 109:     def forward_trunk(self, X):
 110:         z1 = X @ self.params["W1"] + self.params["b1"]
 111:         a1 = relu(z1)
 112:         z2 = a1 @ self.params["W2"] + self.params["b2"]
 113:         a2 = relu(z2)
 114:         return a2, (X, z1, a1, z2, a2)
 115: 
 116:     def backward_trunk(self, cache, da2):
 117:         X, z1, a1, z2, a2 = cache
 118:         dz2 = da2 * relu_grad(z2)
 119:         dW2 = a1.T @ dz2
 120:         db2 = dz2.sum(axis=0)
 121:         da1 = dz2 @ self.params["W2"].T
 122:         dz1 = da1 * relu_grad(z1)
 123:         dW1 = X.T @ dz1
 124:         db1 = dz1.sum(axis=0)
 125:         return {"W1": dW1, "b1": db1, "W2": dW2, "b2": db2}
 126: 
 127: 
 128: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
 129: # 2. GRU
 130: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
 131: class CubeSatGRU(_BaseModel):
 132:     NAME = "GRU"
 133: 
 134:     def __init__(self, input_dim: int, seq_len: int, hidden: int = 10, seed: int = 0):
 135:         assert input_dim % seq_len == 0, "input_dim must be divisible by seq_len"
 136:         self.seq_len = seq_len
 137:         self.feat_per_step = input_dim // seq_len
 138:         self.hidden = hidden
 139:         super().__init__(trunk_dim=hidden, seed=seed)
 140:         rng = self._rng
 141:         F, H = self.feat_per_step, hidden
 142:         sx = np.sqrt(1.0 / F)
 143:         sh = np.sqrt(1.0 / H)
 144:         for gate in ("z", "r", "n"):
 145:             self.params[f"W{gate}"] = (rng.standard_normal((F, H)) * sx).astype(np.float32)
 146:             self.params[f"U{gate}"] = (rng.standard_normal((H, H)) * sh).astype(np.float32)
 147:             self.params[f"b{gate}"] = np.zeros(H, dtype=np.float32)
 148: 
 149:     def forward_trunk(self, X):
 150:         N = X.shape[0]
 151:         Xseq = X.reshape(N, self.seq_len, self.feat_per_step)
 152:         H = self.hidden
 153:         h = np.zeros((N, H), dtype=np.float32)
 154:         steps = []
 155:         for t in range(self.seq_len):
 156:             xt = Xseq[:, t, :]
 157:             h_prev = h
 158:             zt_pre = xt @ self.params["Wz"] + h_prev @ self.params["Uz"] + self.params["bz"]
 159:             rt_pre = xt @ self.params["Wr"] + h_prev @ self.params["Ur"] + self.params["br"]
 160:             z = sigmoid(zt_pre)
 161:             r = sigmoid(rt_pre)
 162:             u = h_prev @ self.params["Un"]
 163:             nt_pre = xt @ self.params["Wn"] + r * u + self.params["bn"]
 164:             n = np.tanh(nt_pre)
 165:             h = (1 - z) * n + z * h_prev
 166:             steps.append((xt, h_prev, z, r, n, u, h))
 167:         return h, steps
 168: 
 169:     def backward_trunk(self, steps, dh_last):
 170:         H = self.hidden
 171:         grads = {k: np.zeros_like(v) for k, v in self.params.items() if k in
 172:                  ("Wz", "Uz", "bz", "Wr", "Ur", "br", "Wn", "Un", "bn")}
 173:         dh = dh_last
 174:         for t in reversed(range(self.seq_len)):
 175:             xt, h_prev, z, r, n, u, h = steps[t]
 176: 
 177:             dn = dh * (1 - z)
 178:             dz = dh * (h_prev - n)
 179:             dh_prev = dh * z  # path 1: h = z * h_prev (+...)
 180: 
 181:             dnt_pre = dn * (1 - n ** 2)
 182:             grads["bn"] += dnt_pre.sum(axis=0)
 183:             grads["Wn"] += xt.T @ dnt_pre
 184:             dru = dnt_pre  # nt_pre = x@Wn + r*u + bn
 185:             dr = dru * u
 186:             du = dru * r
 187:             grads["Un"] += h_prev.T @ du
 188:             dh_prev += du @ self.params["Un"].T
 189: 
 190:             drt_pre = dr * r * (1 - r)
 191:             grads["br"] += drt_pre.sum(axis=0)
 192:             grads["Wr"] += xt.T @ drt_pre
 193:             dh_prev += drt_pre @ self.params["Ur"].T
 194:             grads["Ur"] += h_prev.T @ drt_pre
 195: 
 196:             dzt_pre = dz * z * (1 - z)
 197:             grads["bz"] += dzt_pre.sum(axis=0)
 198:             grads["Wz"] += xt.T @ dzt_pre
 199:             dh_prev += dzt_pre @ self.params["Uz"].T
 200:             grads["Uz"] += h_prev.T @ dzt_pre
 201: 
 202:             dh = dh_prev  # becomes gradient at previous timestep's h
 203:         return grads
 204: 
 205: 
 206: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
 207: # 3. 1-D CNN
 208: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
 209: class CubeSat1DCNN(_BaseModel):
 210:     NAME = "CNN1D"
 211: 
 212:     def __init__(self, input_dim: int, c1: int = 6, c2: int = 10, kernel: int = 3, seed: int = 0):
 213:         self.L = input_dim
 214:         self.c1, self.c2, self.k = c1, c2, kernel
 215:         self.pad = kernel // 2
 216:         super().__init__(trunk_dim=c2, seed=seed)
 217:         rng = self._rng
 218:         s1 = np.sqrt(2.0 / (1 * kernel))
 219:         s2 = np.sqrt(2.0 / (c1 * kernel))
 220:         self.params["W1"] = (rng.standard_normal((c1, 1, kernel)) * s1).astype(np.float32)
 221:         self.params["b1"] = np.zeros(c1, dtype=np.float32)
 222:         self.params["W2"] = (rng.standard_normal((c2, c1, kernel)) * s2).astype(np.float32)
 223:         self.params["b2"] = np.zeros(c2, dtype=np.float32)
 224: 
 225:     @staticmethod
 226:     def _conv1d_forward(X, W, b, pad):
 227:         # X: (N, Cin, L) ; W: (Cout, Cin, K) ; returns (N, Cout, L)
 228:         N, Cin, L = X.shape
 229:         Cout, _, K = W.shape
 230:         Xp = np.pad(X, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (pad, pad)))
 231:         Wflat = W.reshape(Cout, -1)  # (Cout, Cin*K)
 232:         out = np.empty((N, Cout, L), dtype=X.dtype)
 233:         windows = np.empty((L, N, Cin * K), dtype=X.dtype)
 234:         for i in range(L):
 235:             win = Xp[:, :, i:i + K].reshape(N, -1)
 236:             windows[i] = win
 237:             out[:, :, i] = win @ Wflat.T + b
 238:         return out, (Xp, windows, W.shape, pad)
 239: 
 240:     def forward_trunk(self, X):
 241:         N = X.shape[0]
 242:         X1 = X.reshape(N, 1, self.L)
 243:         c1_out, cache1 = self._conv1d_forward(X1, self.params["W1"], self.params["b1"], self.pad)
 244:         a1 = relu(c1_out)
 245:         c2_out, cache2 = self._conv1d_forward(a1, self.params["W2"], self.params["b2"], self.pad)
 246:         a2 = relu(c2_out)
 247:         trunk = a2.mean(axis=2)  # global average pool -> (N, c2)
 248:         cache = (cache1, c1_out, a1, cache2, c2_out, a2, N)
 249:         return trunk, cache
 250: 
 251:     def backward_trunk(self, cache, dtrunk):
 252:         cache1, c1_out, a1, cache2, c2_out, a2, N = cache
 253:         L = self.L
 254:         # undo global avg pool
 255:         da2 = np.repeat((dtrunk / L)[:, :, None], L, axis=2)
 256:         dc2 = da2 * relu_grad(c2_out)
 257: 
 258:         # conv2 backward (manual, correct version using stored weight)
 259:         Xp2, windows2, Wshape2, pad2 = cache2
 260:         Cout2, Cin2, K2 = Wshape2
 261:         W2flat = self.params["W2"].reshape(Cout2, -1)
 262:         dW2 = np.zeros_like(W2flat)
 263:         db2 = np.zeros(Cout2, dtype=dc2.dtype)
 264:         dXp2 = np.zeros_like(Xp2)
 265:         for i in range(L):
 266:             dout_i = dc2[:, :, i]
 267:             win = windows2[i]
 268:             dW2 += dout_i.T @ win
 269:             db2 += dout_i.sum(axis=0)
 270:             dwin = dout_i @ W2flat
 271:             dXp2[:, :, i:i + K2] += dwin.reshape(-1, Cin2, K2)
 272:         da1_from_conv2 = dXp2[:, :, pad2:pad2 + a1.shape[2]]
 273:         dc1 = da1_from_conv2 * relu_grad(c1_out)
 274: 
 275:         # conv1 backward
 276:         Xp1, windows1, Wshape1, pad1 = cache1
 277:         Cout1, Cin1, K1 = Wshape1
 278:         W1flat = self.params["W1"].reshape(Cout1, -1)
 279:         dW1 = np.zeros_like(W1flat)
 280:         db1 = np.zeros(Cout1, dtype=dc1.dtype)
 281:         for i in range(L):
 282:             dout_i = dc1[:, :, i]
 283:             win = windows1[i]
 284:             dW1 += dout_i.T @ win
 285:             db1 += dout_i.sum(axis=0)
 286:             # dX not needed further (input layer)
 287: 
 288:         return {
 289:             "W1": dW1.reshape(Wshape1), "b1": db1,
 290:             "W2": dW2.reshape(Wshape2), "b2": db2,
 291:         }
 292: 
 293: 
 294: MODEL_REGISTRY = {
 295:     "MLP": CubeSatMLP,
 296:     "GRU": CubeSatGRU,
 297:     "CNN1D": CubeSat1DCNN,
 298: }

   1: """Adam optimizer operating on a dict[str, np.ndarray] of parameters.
   2: Handles growing parameters (the shared classification head widens as new
   3: classes are learned) by zero-padding existing momentum/variance state to
   4: the new shape -- new columns start with fresh (zero) moments while
   5: existing columns keep their accumulated momentum."""
   6: import numpy as np
   7: 
   8: 
   9: def _pad_state_to_shape(arr: np.ndarray, target_shape: tuple) -> np.ndarray:
  10:     if arr.shape == target_shape:
  11:         return arr
  12:     padded = np.zeros(target_shape, dtype=arr.dtype)
  13:     slices = tuple(slice(0, s) for s in arr.shape)
  14:     padded[slices] = arr
  15:     return padded
  16: 
  17: 
  18: class Adam:
  19:     def __init__(self, lr=1e-3, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.0):
  20:         self.lr = lr
  21:         self.b1 = beta1
  22:         self.b2 = beta2
  23:         self.eps = eps
  24:         self.wd = weight_decay
  25:         self.m = {}
  26:         self.v = {}
  27:         self.t = {}
  28: 
  29:     def step(self, params: dict, grads: dict):
  30:         for k, g in grads.items():
  31:             if g is None:
  32:                 continue
  33:             p = params[k]
  34:             if self.wd > 0:
  35:                 g = g + self.wd * p
  36:             if k not in self.m:
  37:                 self.m[k] = np.zeros_like(p)
  38:                 self.v[k] = np.zeros_like(p)
  39:                 self.t[k] = 0
  40:             elif self.m[k].shape != p.shape:
  41:                 # parameter grew (new head columns) -- preserve existing
  42:                 # momentum for old entries, zero-init the new ones
  43:                 self.m[k] = _pad_state_to_shape(self.m[k], p.shape)
  44:                 self.v[k] = _pad_state_to_shape(self.v[k], p.shape)
  45:             self.t[k] += 1
  46:             self.m[k] = self.b1 * self.m[k] + (1 - self.b1) * g
  47:             self.v[k] = self.b2 * self.v[k] + (1 - self.b2) * (g * g)
  48:             mhat = self.m[k] / (1 - self.b1 ** self.t[k])
  49:             vhat = self.v[k] / (1 - self.b2 ** self.t[k])
  50:             params[k] -= self.lr * mhat / (np.sqrt(vhat) + self.eps)

FILE: ./src/parallel.py (2.2 KB)
================================================================================
   1: """Small process-based parallelism helper.
   2: 
   3: The numerical backends are single-threaded NumPy; the pipeline's parallelism
   4: comes from running independent (dataset, arch, method, seed) jobs in separate
   5: processes.  Four workers is the default on this machine (4 physical cores;
   6: the CPU also exposes 8 SMT threads, which would oversubscribe the FP units).
   7: Override with CL_JOBS=<n>.
   8: """
   9: from __future__ import annotations
  10: 
  11: import multiprocessing as mp
  12: import os
  13: from typing import Callable, Iterable, Iterator, Sequence
  14: 
  15: 
  16: DEFAULT_JOBS = 4
  17: 
  18: 
  19: def configure_single_thread() -> None:
  20:     """Pin BLAS/OpenMP runtimes to one thread per worker.
  21: 
  22:     Must run before NumPy is imported for the environment variables to take
  23:     effect.  Every experiment script imports this module before numpy.
  24:     """
  25:     for key in (
  26:         "OMP_NUM_THREADS",
  27:         "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS",
  28:         "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
  29:         "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS",
  30:         "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS",
  31:         "BLIS_NUM_THREADS",
  32:     ):
  33:         os.environ[key] = "1"
  34: 
  35: 
  36: def available_cpus() -> int:
  37:     try:
  38:         return max(1, len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)))
  39:     except AttributeError:
  40:         return max(1, os.cpu_count() or 1)
  41: 
  42: 
  43: def get_jobs(requested: int | None = None) -> int:
  44:     if requested is not None:
  45:         return max(1, int(requested))
  46:     env = os.environ.get("CL_JOBS")
  47:     if env:
  48:         return max(1, int(env))
  49:     return min(DEFAULT_JOBS, available_cpus())
  50: 
  51: 
  52: def parallel_map(func: Callable, items: Sequence, jobs: int | None = None,
  53:                  chunksize: int = 1) -> Iterator:
  54:     """Ordered parallel map using fork.
  55: 
  56:     Workers inherit module globals (pre-built task sequences, frozen
  57:     hyperparameters) because the platform is Linux.  Keeping a single mapping
  58:     function and pre-fork globals avoids pickling large datasets for every run.
  59:     """
  60:     jobs = get_jobs(jobs)
  61:     if jobs <= 1 or len(items) <= 1:
  62:         for item in items:
  63:             yield func(item)
  64:         return
  65: 
  66:     ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
  67:     with ctx.Pool(processes=jobs) as pool:
  68:         yield from pool.imap(func, items, chunksize=chunksize)
  69: 
  70: 
  71: def describe(jobs: int | None = None) -> str:
  72:     return f"{get_jobs(jobs)} worker process(es), one BLAS thread per worker"

FILE: ./src/train.py (18.5 KB)
================================================================================
   1: """
   2: Class-incremental continual-learning training loop.
   3: 
   4: Unlike a task-incremental setup, there is no task ID at inference time: all
   5: classes learned so far are discriminated through ONE shared, dynamically
   6: growing softmax head (`model.expand_head`). Each Task's labels are stored
   7: locally (0..n_new_classes-1, see `src/data_utils.py`); this loop resolves
   8: them to the model's actual global head-column indices *dynamically*, based
   9: on the order tasks are processed in (`class_offset` below) -- so the very
  10: same TaskSequence can safely be replayed in a different task order (used by
  11: the task-order-sensitivity ablation) without corrupting label alignment.
  12: 
  13: Methods:
  14:   finetune -- naive sequential fine-tuning, no CMMU. Lower-bound baseline,
  15:               expected to catastrophically forget earlier classes -- and,
  16:               under the class-incremental protocol, doubly so, since new-
  17:               class training actively pushes down old classes' logits via
  18:               softmax competition even before considering weight drift.
  19:   replay   -- CMMU sub-mechanism A only (experience replay buffer).
  20:   ewc      -- CMMU sub-mechanism B only (online EWC regularisation covering
  21:               the shared head as well as the trunk; Fisher is estimated from
  22:               the cumulative old+new validation pool, not new-task data alone).
  23:   full     -- both CMMU sub-mechanisms combined (the proposed system).
  24:   joint    -- LEGACY cumulative warm-start: trains on the union of all
  25:               classes' training data seen so far but continues from current
  26:               weights at every task boundary. Kept for comparability with
  27:               old CSVs; do NOT cite as a strict upper bound.
  28:   joint_scratch -- (Phase 0) offline joint-training reference (NOT a strict
  29:                upper bound: warm-start joint can exceed it): at each task boundary
  30:               the model AND optimizer are re-initialised from scratch and
  31:               trained on the union of training data seen so far. Strictly
  32:               stronger reference than `joint`.
  33:   lwf      -- (Phase 1) Learning-without-Forgetting: memory-free distillation
  34:               from a frozen teacher snapshot (Hinton T, lambda); no replay.
  35:   bic      -- (Phase 1) replay (herding, balanced) + distillation + BiC
  36:               bias-correction stage fit on held-out val (alpha,beta on new
  37:               logits, Wu et al. 2019 lite: correction at inference, trunk
  38:               frozen during fit).
  39:   icarl    -- (Phase 1 lite) herding buffer + balanced replay + distillation,
  40:               softmax eval (embedding-space herding / NCM omitted; documented
  41:               limitation vs full iCaRL).
  42: """
  43: from __future__ import annotations
  44: import time
  45: import numpy as np
  46: 
  47: from optim import Adam
  48: from cmmu import ReplayBuffer, OnlineEWC
  49: from losses import softmax_cross_entropy
  50: from utils import set_seed
  51: 
  52: 
  53: DEFAULT_HPARAMS = dict(
  54:     lr=3e-3,
  55:     epochs=25,
  56:     batch_size=32,
  57:     ewc_lambda=1000.0,
  58:     ewc_gamma=1.0,  # fallback only: frozen per-arch configs always override
  59:                     # (EWC-only: MLP 0.5 / GRU 1.0 / CNN 0.5); gamma is
  60:                     # treated as a validation-tuned weighting parameter, not
  61:                     # a decay factor
  62:     fisher_n_samples=200,
  63:     buffer_capacity=128,
  64:     replay_frac=0.5,
  65:     # Phase 1 distillation / BiC-iCaRL knobs (defaults keep old runs identical
  66:     # when the new methods are not selected).
  67:     distill_lambda=1.0,   # weight on KD term for lwf/bic/icarl (CE gets 1-distill_lambda when <1)
  68:     distill_T=2.0,        # Hinton temperature for soft targets
  69: )
  70: 
  71: 
  72: def _softmax_T(logits: np.ndarray, T: float) -> np.ndarray:
  73:     z = (logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)) / max(T, 1e-8)
  74:     exp = np.exp(z)
  75:     return exp / exp.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
  76: 
  77: 
  78: def _distill_dlogits(student_logits: np.ndarray, teacher_logits_old: np.ndarray,
  79:                      T: float, lam: float) -> np.ndarray:
  80:     """Gradient of lam * T^2 * KL(teacher_old/T || student_old/T) averaged over
  81:     the batch, padded with zeros for new-class columns. Follows Hinton et al.
  82:     (the T^2 keeps the KD step magnitude comparable across temperatures)."""
  83:     n_old = teacher_logits_old.shape[1]
  84:     if n_old == 0:
  85:         return np.zeros_like(student_logits)
  86:     p_t = _softmax_T(teacher_logits_old, T)
  87:     p_s = _softmax_T(student_logits[:, :n_old], T)
  88:     N = student_logits.shape[0]
  89:     g_old = lam * (T ** 2) * (p_s - p_t) / (T * max(N, 1))
  90:     out = np.zeros_like(student_logits)
  91:     out[:, :n_old] = g_old
  92:     return out
  93: 
  94: 
  95: def _snapshot_teacher(model_cls, model_kwargs, model, seed: int):
  96:     """Frozen copy of the current model (trunk + old head width). The teacher
  97:     is never expanded again; student grows past it."""
  98:     teacher = model_cls(**model_kwargs, seed=seed)
  99:     for k, v in model.params.items():
 100:         teacher.params[k] = v.copy()
 101:     return teacher
 102: 
 103: 
 104: def _rebuild_herding_buffer(buffer, per_class_data: dict, capacity: int):
 105:     """Phase 1 iCaRL-style buffer rebuild: equal exemplars per class, herding
 106:     selection in input space (documented limitation: embedding-space herding
 107:     would need trunk access per arch; input-space is the honest lite version).
 108:     per_class_data: {global_class_id: X (N,F)}. Clears buffer first."""
 109:     from cmmu import ReplayBuffer
 110:     buffer.size = 0
 111:     buffer.n_seen = 0
 112:     if not per_class_data:
 113:         return
 114:     classes = sorted(per_class_data.keys())
 115:     per = max(1, capacity // max(1, len(classes)))
 116:     for c in classes:
 117:         X = np.asarray(per_class_data[c])
 118:         if len(X) == 0:
 119:             continue
 120:         sel = ReplayBuffer.select_herding(X, min(per, len(X)))
 121:         for i in sel:
 122:             if buffer.size >= buffer.capacity:
 123:                 return
 124:             buffer.X[buffer.size] = X[i]
 125:             buffer.y[buffer.size] = c
 126:             buffer.task_id[buffer.size] = -1  # herding rebuild loses task id; eval doesn't need it
 127:             buffer.size += 1
 128: 
 129: 
 130: def _train_step_batch(model, xb, yb, opt, ewc, teacher=None, teacher_logits=None,
 131:                         distill_lam: float = 0.0, distill_T: float = 2.0):
 132:     """One Adam step on a (possibly replay-augmented) minibatch, all routed
 133:     through the single shared head -- no per-task grouping needed.
 134:     When teacher_logits (old-head soft targets) are given, adds the KD
 135:     gradient on old-class columns (LwF/BiC/iCaRL family)."""
 136:     logits, cache = model.forward(xb)
 137:     loss, dlogits, _ = softmax_cross_entropy(logits, yb)
 138:     if teacher_logits is not None and distill_lam > 0:
 139:         # Additive KD (keeps full CE on new classes; lam scales old-class
 140:         # retention). NOTE: earlier convex combo (1-lam)*CE killed plasticity
 141:         # at lam=1 -- fixed after 3-epoch smoke showed lwf ACC~=chance.
 142:         dlogits = dlogits + _distill_dlogits(logits, teacher_logits, distill_T, distill_lam)
 143:     grads = model.backward(cache, dlogits)
 144: 
 145:     if ewc is not None:
 146:         pen_g = ewc.penalty_grad(model.params)
 147:         for k, v in pen_g.items():
 148:             grads[k] = grads.get(k, 0.0) + v
 149: 
 150:     opt.step(model.params, grads)
 151:     return loss
 152: 
 153: 
 154: class BiasCorrector:
 155:     """Phase 0 BiC-style inference hook (Wu et al., 2019, light version).
 156: 
 157:     Models the well-known new-class head bias as
 158:         logits_new_corrected = alpha * logits_new + beta
 159:     with old-class logits untouched. One (alpha, beta) pair is fit per
 160:     incremental stage on held-out val/buffer data with trunk+head frozen
 161:     (grid search on accuracy); full BiC two-stage training lands in Phase 1.
 162:     """
 163: 
 164:     def __init__(self):
 165:         self.stages = []  # list of dicts {n_old, n_new, alpha, beta}
 166: 
 167:     @property
 168:     def fitted(self) -> bool:
 169:         return len(self.stages) > 0
 170: 
 171:     def apply(self, logits: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 172:         out = logits.copy()
 173:         for s in self.stages:
 174:             n_old, n_new, alpha, beta = s["n_old"], s["n_new"], s["alpha"], s["beta"]
 175:             if logits.shape[1] >= n_old + n_new:
 176:                 out[:, n_old:n_old + n_new] = alpha * out[:, n_old:n_old + n_new] + beta
 177:         return out
 178: 
 179:     def fit_stage(self, logits_val: np.ndarray, y_val: np.ndarray,
 180:                   n_old: int, n_new: int, alphas=None, betas=None) -> dict:
 181:         if alphas is None:
 182:             alphas = np.concatenate([[1.0], np.linspace(0.1, 2.0, 12)])
 183:         if betas is None:
 184:             betas = np.array([0.0])
 185:         # Apply corrections from earlier stages before fitting this stage.
 186:         # Otherwise stage t is selected against uncorrected logits, so the
 187:         # deployed sequence of corrections is not the sequence that was fitted.
 188:         logits_val = self.apply(logits_val)
 189:         best = {"n_old": n_old, "n_new": n_new, "alpha": 1.0, "beta": 0.0, "acc": -1.0}
 190:         for a in alphas:
 191:             for b in betas:
 192:                 corr = logits_val.copy()
 193:                 corr[:, n_old:n_old + n_new] = float(a) * corr[:, n_old:n_old + n_new] + float(b)
 194:                 acc = float((corr.argmax(axis=1) == y_val).mean()) if len(y_val) else -1.0
 195:                 if acc > best["acc"]:
 196:                     best = {"n_old": n_old, "n_new": n_new, "alpha": float(a), "beta": float(b), "acc": acc}
 197:         self.stages.append({k: best[k] for k in ("n_old", "n_new", "alpha", "beta")})
 198:         return best
 199: 
 200: 
 201: def train_continual(model_cls, model_kwargs, task_seq, method: str, hparams: dict, seed: int = 0,
 202:                     bias_correction: bool = False, replay_balance: str = "uniform"):
 203:     assert method in ("finetune", "replay", "ewc", "full", "joint", "joint_scratch",
 204:                       "lwf", "bic", "icarl")
 205:     assert replay_balance in ("uniform", "class_balanced")
 206:     hp = {**DEFAULT_HPARAMS, **hparams}
 207:     set_seed(seed)
 208:     rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
 209: 
 210:     model = model_cls(**model_kwargs, seed=seed)
 211:     opt = Adam(lr=hp["lr"])
 212: 
 213:     NEED_BUFFER = method in ("replay", "full", "bic", "icarl")
 214:     NEED_DISTILL = method in ("lwf", "bic", "icarl")
 215:     NEED_BIC_FIT = method in ("bic",) or bias_correction
 216:     buffer = ReplayBuffer(hp["buffer_capacity"], task_seq.n_features, seed=seed) \
 217:         if NEED_BUFFER else None
 218:     ewc = OnlineEWC(lam=hp["ewc_lambda"], gamma=hp["ewc_gamma"],
 219:                      fisher_n_samples=hp["fisher_n_samples"], seed=seed) \
 220:         if method in ("ewc", "full") else None
 221:     corrector = BiasCorrector() if NEED_BIC_FIT else None
 222:     # BiC/iCaRL papers mandate balanced rehearsal; force it regardless of flag.
 223:     use_balanced = (replay_balance == "class_balanced") or method in ("bic", "icarl")
 224:     distill_lam = float(hp.get("distill_lambda", 1.0))
 225:     distill_T = float(hp.get("distill_T", 2.0))
 226: 
 227:     T = len(task_seq.tasks)
 228:     R = np.full((T, T), np.nan)
 229:     V = np.full((T, T), np.nan)  # Validation accuracy matrix
 230:     per_task_train_seconds = []
 231:     joint_pool = []          # for method="joint"/"joint_scratch": list of (X, y_global)
 232:     seen_tasks = []          # list of (X_test, y_test_global) for tasks processed so far
 233:     seen_val_tasks = []      # list of (X_select, y_select_global) for validation SCORING
 234:     seen_val = []            # list of (X_calib, y_calib_global) for BiC/Fisher fitting
 235:     class_offset = 0         # cumulative #classes introduced so far, in PROCESSING order
 236:     n_classes_before = []    # n_old at each stage (for bias correction)
 237:     last_teacher = None      # frozen teacher from the most recent incremental stage (for peak-RAM accounting)
 238:     train_steps_total = 0    # minibatch optimizer steps actually performed
 239:     train_samples_total = 0  # student samples actually processed (incl. replay augmentation)
 240:     teacher_samples_total = 0  # teacher-forward samples actually processed (distillation methods)
 241: 
 242:     for t, task in enumerate(task_seq.tasks):
 243:         n_old = class_offset
 244:         n_classes_before.append(n_old)
 245:         # Teacher snapshot BEFORE growing the head (frozen old trunk+head).
 246:         teacher = None
 247:         if NEED_DISTILL and n_old > 0:
 248:             teacher = _snapshot_teacher(model_cls, model_kwargs, model, seed)
 249:             last_teacher = teacher
 250:         if method == "joint_scratch":
 251:             # Offline reference: fresh weights + fresh optimizer at every boundary.
 252:             model = model_cls(**model_kwargs, seed=seed)
 253:             opt = Adam(lr=hp["lr"])
 254:             for tt in range(t + 1):
 255:                 if model.n_classes_total < sum(task_seq.tasks[j].n_new_classes for j in range(tt + 1)):
 256:                     model.expand_head(task_seq.tasks[tt].n_new_classes)
 257:         else:
 258:             model.expand_head(task.n_new_classes)
 259:         y_train_global = task.y_train + class_offset
 260:         y_test_global = task.y_test + class_offset
 261:         y_calib_global = task.y_calib + class_offset if task.y_calib is not None else None
 262:         y_select_global = task.y_select + class_offset if task.y_select is not None else None
 263:         class_offset += task.n_new_classes
 264: 
 265:         if method in ("joint", "joint_scratch"):
 266:             joint_pool.append((task.X_train, y_train_global))
 267:             pool = joint_pool
 268:         else:
 269:             pool = [(task.X_train, y_train_global)]
 270: 
 271:         t0 = time.perf_counter()
 272:         for epoch in range(hp["epochs"]):
 273:             Xc = np.concatenate([x for x, y in pool], axis=0)
 274:             yc = np.concatenate([y for x, y in pool], axis=0)
 275:             perm = rng.permutation(len(Xc))
 276:             Xc, yc = Xc[perm], yc[perm]
 277: 
 278:             for start in range(0, len(Xc), hp["batch_size"]):
 279:                 xb = Xc[start:start + hp["batch_size"]]
 280:                 yb = yc[start:start + hp["batch_size"]]
 281: 
 282:                 if buffer is not None and buffer.size > 0:
 283:                     n_replay = max(1, int(len(xb) * hp["replay_frac"]))
 284:                     if use_balanced and hasattr(buffer, "sample_balanced"):
 285:                         sampled = buffer.sample_balanced(n_replay)
 286:                     else:
 287:                         sampled = buffer.sample(n_replay)
 288:                     if sampled is not None:
 289:                         rx, ry, _ = sampled
 290:                         xb = np.concatenate([xb, rx], axis=0)
 291:                         yb = np.concatenate([yb, ry], axis=0)
 292: 
 293:                 t_logits = None
 294:                 if teacher is not None:
 295:                     t_logits, _ = teacher.forward(xb)
 296:                     teacher_samples_total += int(xb.shape[0])
 297:                 train_steps_total += 1
 298:                 train_samples_total += int(yb.shape[0])
 299:                 _train_step_batch(model, xb, yb, opt, ewc,
 300:                                   teacher_logits=t_logits,
 301:                                   distill_lam=distill_lam if teacher is not None else 0.0,
 302:                                   distill_T=distill_T)
 303:         per_task_train_seconds.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
 304: 
 305:         # ---- evaluate on all tasks seen so far, using the FULL current
 306:         #      shared head (no task ID / no restriction to a subset of
 307:         #      classes -- this is the crux of the class-incremental setting) ----
 308:         seen_tasks.append((task.X_test, y_test_global))
 309:         if task.X_calib is not None and y_calib_global is not None:
 310:             seen_val.append((task.X_calib, y_calib_global))
 311:         if task.X_select is not None and y_select_global is not None:
 312:             seen_val_tasks.append((task.X_select, y_select_global))
 313:         # Phase 1 BiC: fit one bias stage on held-out val (frozen model) before
 314:         # eval; full (alpha,beta) grid for method="bic", alpha-only for the
 315:         # generic bias_correction hook.
 316:         if corrector is not None and seen_val and n_old > 0:
 317:             Xv = np.concatenate([x for x, y in seen_val], axis=0)
 318:             yv = np.concatenate([y for x, y in seen_val], axis=0)
 319:             logits_v, _ = model.forward(Xv)
 320:             if method == "bic":
 321:                 corrector.fit_stage(logits_v, yv, n_old, task.n_new_classes,
 322:                                     betas=np.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, 9))
 323:             else:
 324:                 corrector.fit_stage(logits_v, yv, n_old, task.n_new_classes)
 325:         for j, (Xj, yj) in enumerate(seen_tasks):
 326:             logits, _ = model.forward(Xj)
 327:             if corrector is not None and corrector.fitted:
 328:                 logits = corrector.apply(logits)
 329:             preds = logits.argmax(axis=1)
 330:             R[t, j] = float((preds == yj).mean())
 331:         # Validation accuracy matrix on the DISJOINT selection half only.
 332:         for j, (Xj, yj) in enumerate(seen_val_tasks):
 333:             logits, _ = model.forward(Xj)
 334:             if corrector is not None and corrector.fitted:
 335:                 logits = corrector.apply(logits)
 336:             preds = logits.argmax(axis=1)
 337:             V[t, j] = float((preds == yj).mean())
 338: 
 339:         # ---- update CMMU state ----
 340:         if buffer is not None:
 341:             if method in ("bic", "icarl"):
 342:                 # Bounded herding rebuild: candidates are resident buffer
 343:                 # exemplars + incoming task batch only (no unbounded history).
 344:                 per_class_data = {}
 345:                 if buffer.size > 0:
 346:                     buf_X = np.asarray(buffer.X[:buffer.size])
 347:                     buf_y = np.asarray(buffer.y[:buffer.size])
 348:                     for g_old in np.unique(buf_y).tolist():
 349:                         per_class_data[int(g_old)] = buf_X[buf_y == g_old].copy()
 350:                 base = class_offset - task.n_new_classes
 351:                 for c_local in range(task.n_new_classes):
 352:                     g = base + c_local
 353:                     mask = (y_train_global == g)
 354:                     if np.any(mask):
 355:                         per_class_data[g] = task.X_train[mask].copy()
 356:                 _rebuild_herding_buffer(buffer, per_class_data, int(hp["buffer_capacity"]))
 357:             else:
 358:                 buffer.add_batch(task.X_train, y_train_global, t)
 359:         if ewc is not None:
 360:             # Use the cumulative calibration pool (all tasks seen so far), not
 361:             # only the current task's calibration slice. The old behaviour estimated
 362:             # Fisher on one new class at a time, which understated old-task
 363:             # curvature and made the running estimate depend on task order.
 364:             if seen_val:
 365:                 Xv = np.concatenate([x for x, y in seen_val], axis=0)
 366:                 yv = np.concatenate([y for x, y in seen_val], axis=0)
 367:                 ewc.consolidate(model, task.X_train, y_train_global,
 368:                                 X_val=Xv, y_val=yv)
 369:             else:
 370:                 ewc.consolidate(model, task.X_train, y_train_global)
 371: 
 372:     return {
 373:         "R": R,
 374:         "V": V,
 375:         "model": model,
 376:         "buffer": buffer,
 377:         "ewc": ewc,
 378:         "corrector": corrector,
 379:         "teacher": last_teacher,
 380:         "train_steps_total": train_steps_total,
 381:         "train_samples_total": train_samples_total,
 382:         "teacher_samples_total": teacher_samples_total,
 383:         "per_task_train_seconds": per_task_train_seconds,
 384:         "hparams": hp,
 385:         "replay_balance": replay_balance,
 386:         "bias_correction": bias_correction,
 387:     }

================================================================================
FILE: ./tests/test_gradients.py (5.5 KB)
================================================================================
   1: """Numerical gradient checks for CubeSatMLP / CubeSatGRU / CubeSat1DCNN.
   2: 
   3: Run: python3 tests/test_gradients.py
   4: """
   5: import sys, os
   6: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
   7: 
   8: import numpy as np
   9: from models import CubeSatMLP, CubeSatGRU, CubeSat1DCNN
  10: from losses import softmax_cross_entropy
  11: from train import _distill_dlogits
  12: from cmmu import OnlineEWC
  13: 
  14: 
  15: def _to_float64(model):
  16:     for k in list(model.params.keys()):
  17:         model.params[k] = model.params[k].astype(np.float64)
  18: 
  19: 
  20: def numeric_grad_check(model, X, y, eps=1e-5, n_check=8, tol=1e-2):
  21:     _to_float64(model)
  22:     X = X.astype(np.float64)
  23: 
  24:     logits, cache = model.forward(X)
  25:     loss, dlogits, _ = softmax_cross_entropy(logits, y)
  26:     grads = model.backward(cache, dlogits)
  27: 
  28:     rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
  29:     worst = 0.0
  30:     n_fail = 0
  31:     n_total = 0
  32:     for name, garr in grads.items():
  33:         p = model.params[name]
  34:         flat_idx = rng.choice(p.size, size=min(n_check, p.size), replace=False)
  35:         for fi in flat_idx:
  36:             orig = p.flat[fi]
  37:             p.flat[fi] = orig + eps
  38:             logits_p, _ = model.forward(X)
  39:             loss_p, _, _ = softmax_cross_entropy(logits_p, y)
  40:             p.flat[fi] = orig - eps
  41:             logits_m, _ = model.forward(X)
  42:             loss_m, _, _ = softmax_cross_entropy(logits_m, y)
  43:             p.flat[fi] = orig
  44:             numeric = (loss_p - loss_m) / (2 * eps)
  45:             analytic = garr.flat[fi]
  46:             # combined absolute+relative criterion (standard practice; avoids
  47:             # blow-up near zero-crossings / ReLU kinks that pure relative
  48:             # error is oversensitive to)
  49:             err = abs(numeric - analytic) / max(1.0, abs(numeric) + abs(analytic))
  50:             n_total += 1
  51:             worst = max(worst, err)
  52:             if err >= tol:
  53:                 n_fail += 1
  54:                 print(f"  [FAIL] {name}[{fi}] numeric={numeric:.6f} analytic={analytic:.6f} err={err:.5f}")
  55:     print(f"  -> worst combined error: {worst:.6f} over {n_total} checked entries ({n_fail} failing)")
  56:     assert worst < tol, "Gradient check failed"
  57: 
  58: 
  59: def check_distill_gradient(seed=3):
  60:     """Finite-difference check of the KD gradient (old-class columns only)."""
  61:     rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
  62:     student = rng.standard_normal((6, 5)).astype(np.float64)
  63:     teacher = rng.standard_normal((6, 3)).astype(np.float64)
  64:     T, lam = 2.0, 0.7
  65: 
  66:     def kd_loss(z):
  67:         p_t = np.exp(teacher / T); p_t /= p_t.sum(1, keepdims=True)
  68:         zz = z[:, :3] / T
  69:         p_s = np.exp(zz - zz.max(1, keepdims=True))
  70:         p_s /= p_s.sum(1, keepdims=True)
  71:         return lam * T * T * np.sum(p_t * (np.log(np.clip(p_t, 1e-12, None)) -
  72:                                           np.log(np.clip(p_s, 1e-12, None)))) / len(z)
  73: 
  74:     analytic = _distill_dlogits(student, teacher, T, lam)
  75:     eps = 1e-6
  76:     worst = 0.0
  77:     for idx in [(0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 2), (0, 4), (5, 3)]:
  78:         z = student.copy()
  79:         z[idx] += eps
  80:         lp = kd_loss(z)
  81:         z[idx] -= 2 * eps
  82:         lm = kd_loss(z)
  83:         num = (lp - lm) / (2 * eps)
  84:         err = abs(num - analytic[idx]) / max(1.0, abs(num) + abs(analytic[idx]))
  85:         worst = max(worst, err)
  86:     assert worst < 1e-5, f"KD gradient error {worst}"
  87:     print(f"  -> KD gradient worst error: {worst:.2e}")
  88: 
  89: 
  90: def check_ewc_penalty_gradient(seed=4):
  91:     """Finite-difference check of the EWC quadratic penalty gradient."""
  92:     rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
  93:     m = CubeSatMLP(input_dim=7, h1=5, h2=4, seed=seed)
  94:     m.expand_head(3)
  95:     ewc = OnlineEWC(lam=3.0, gamma=1.0)
  96:     ewc.fisher = {k: rng.random(v.shape) for k, v in m.params.items()}
  97:     ewc.anchor = {k: v.copy() for k, v in m.params.items()}
  98:     ewc._consolidated = True
  99:     grads = ewc.penalty_grad(m.params)
 100:     eps = 1e-6
 101:     worst = 0.0
 102:     for name in list(m.params)[:3]:
 103:         arr = m.params[name]
 104:         idx = tuple(0 for _ in arr.shape)
 105:         orig = arr[idx]
 106:         arr[idx] = orig + eps
 107:         lp = ewc.penalty_loss(m.params)
 108:         arr[idx] = orig - eps
 109:         lm = ewc.penalty_loss(m.params)
 110:         arr[idx] = orig
 111:         num = (lp - lm) / (2 * eps)
 112:         ana = grads[name][idx]
 113:         err = abs(num - ana) / max(1.0, abs(num) + abs(ana))
 114:         worst = max(worst, err)
 115:     assert worst < 1e-5, f"EWC penalty gradient error {worst}"
 116:     print(f"  -> EWC penalty gradient worst error: {worst:.2e}")
 117: 
 118: 
 119: def main():
 120:     rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
 121:     N, F = 9, 12
 122:     X = rng.standard_normal((N, F)).astype(np.float32)
 123:     y = rng.integers(0, 3, size=N)
 124: 
 125:     print("== CubeSatMLP ==")
 126:     m = CubeSatMLP(input_dim=F, h1=10, h2=7, seed=1)
 127:     m.expand_head(3)
 128:     numeric_grad_check(m, X, y)
 129: 
 130:     print("== CubeSatGRU ==")
 131:     m = CubeSatGRU(input_dim=F, seq_len=4, hidden=6, seed=1)  # 12 = 4*3
 132:     m.expand_head(3)
 133:     numeric_grad_check(m, X, y)
 134: 
 135:     print("== CubeSat1DCNN ==")
 136:     m = CubeSat1DCNN(input_dim=F, c1=4, c2=5, kernel=3, seed=1)
 137:     m.expand_head(3)
 138:     numeric_grad_check(m, X, y)
 139: 
 140:     print("== Growing head (class-incremental) gradient check ==")
 141:     m = CubeSatMLP(input_dim=F, h1=10, h2=7, seed=1)
 142:     m.expand_head(2)          # task 0: 2 classes
 143:     y2 = rng.integers(0, 2, size=N)
 144:     numeric_grad_check(m, X, y2)
 145:     m.expand_head(2)          # task 1: 2 more classes appended (now 4 total)
 146:     y4 = rng.integers(0, 4, size=N)
 147:     numeric_grad_check(m, X, y4)
 148: 
 149:     print("\n== KD gradient ==")
 150:     check_distill_gradient()
 151: 
 152:     print("\n== EWC penalty gradient ==")
 153:     check_ewc_penalty_gradient()
 154: 
 155:     print("\nALL GRADIENT CHECKS PASSED")
 156: 
 157: 
 158: if __name__ == "__main__":
 159:     main()

   1: """Ensure task-order permutations do not change splits or the launch scaler."""
   2: import os
   3: import sys
   4: 
   5: import numpy as np
   6:

   9: 
  10: 
  11: def main():
  12:     root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
  13:     df = du.load_cucd_id(
  14:         os.path.join(root, "data/CuCD-ID/noised_dataset.csv"),
  15:         os.path.join(root, "data/CuCD-ID/label_schema.json"))
  16:     a = du.build_cucd_id_tasks_order(df, [0, 1, 2, 3], seed=0, budget_mode="fixed_position")
  17:     b = du.build_cucd_id_tasks_order(df, [3, 2, 1, 0], seed=0, budget_mode="fixed_position")
  18:     assert np.allclose(a.scaler_mean, b.scaler_mean)
  19:     assert np.allclose(a.scaler_std, b.scaler_std)
  20:     tests_a, tests_b = {}, {}
  21:     for ts, out in ((a, tests_a), (b, tests_b)):
  22:         for task in ts.tasks:
  23:             for c in range(task.n_new_classes):
  24:                 out[task.class_names[c]] = task.X_test[task.y_test == c]
  25:     assert set(tests_a) == set(tests_b)
  26:     for name in tests_a:
  27:         assert np.array_equal(tests_a[name], tests_b[name]), name
  28: 
  29:     def by_class(ts, attr_x, attr_y):
  30:         out = {}
  31:         for task in ts.tasks:
  32:             X = getattr(task, attr_x)
  33:             y = getattr(task, attr_y)
  34:             if X is None:
  35:                 continue
  36:             for c in range(task.n_new_classes):
  37:                 out[task.class_names[c]] = X[y == c]
  38:         return out
  39: 
  40:     for attr_x, attr_y in (("X_calib", "y_calib"), ("X_select", "y_select")):
  41:         ca, cb = by_class(a, attr_x, attr_y), by_class(b, attr_x, attr_y)
  42:         assert set(ca) == set(cb)
  43:         for name in ca:
  44:             assert np.array_equal(ca[name], cb[name]), (attr_x, name)
  45: 
  46:     print("test_task_order: OK")
  47: 
  48: 
  49: if __name__ == "__main__":
  50:     main()
